title: Regulatory reporting product manager (f/m/d)
description:
Regulatory reporting product manager (f/m/d)
Location: Luxembourg, LU
Company: Deutsche Börse Group

Your area of work:

Clearstream Fund Services is seeking an experienced Product Manager to lead the development and delivery of regulatory reporting solutions within the fund industry. The role focuses on key regulations such as PRIIPs, MiFID, SFDR, and the production of factsheets. The ideal candidate will act as the bridge between business and technology, ensuring compliance, accuracy, and timely delivery of data products that meet regulatory requirements.
This position requires detailed domain knowledge of the funds industry and the associated regulatory regimes, strong ability to work autonomously, a good understanding of how managed services operate, fast-decision-making skills, a thinking-outside-the-box approach and strong stakeholder management skills.

Your responsibilities:

• Own the product lifecycle for chosen regulatory reporting solutions: from identifying opportunities, gathering requirements, and writing specifications for IT development, to deployment and operational readiness as a managed service.
• Ensure compliance and accuracy: translate regulatory obligations placed on our clients (e.g. PRIIPs, MiFID, SFDR, AIFMD) into clear product requirements and maintain alignment with evolving rules.
• Bridge between business and IT: facilitate communication between clients, sales, operations, and technical teams to ensure shared understanding of goals and value to be created by our services.
• Enable technical delivery: collaborate with analysts, architects, and developers to design and implement robust data models and reporting solutions.
• Deliver full-stack reporting products: oversee both back-end processes (data ingestion, modeling) and front-end outputs (factsheets, disclosures, dashboards).
• Drive Agile practices: manage backlog, prioritize tasks based on regulatory deadlines and business needs, and contribute to sprint planning and iterative delivery.
• Document and communicate: produce clear requirements, user stories, and presentations of released solutions, and manage proactive communication with management.
• Act autonomously: make informed decisions, manage priorities, and ensure timely delivery without constant supervision.

Your profile:

• Master's degree in Economics, Finance, Business, or a related field.
• 3-6 years of experience in the funds industry, with strong exposure to regulatory reporting regimes (e,g, PRIIPs, MiFID, SFDR, AIFMD).
• Solid understanding of regulatory frameworks and their practical implications for data and reporting.
• Strong grasp of data ecosystems, software building skills and Agile methodologies.
• Knowledge of data quality, lineage, and governance practices.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Ability to work independently and take ownership of decisions.
• Fluent in English; French is a plus.

In case you are selected for an interview, you will be asked to present a case study that will be communicated to you in advance.

title: Senior Specialist, Product Operations - (Logistics Service) (Business-Analyst/in)
description:
Company Description

As the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience, fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide, powered by tech, designed by people. As one of Europe’s largest tech platforms, headquartered in Berlin, Germany, Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. We push hard, learn quickly and stay human along the way. It’s this wonderful mix of high performance and real community that makes Delivery Hero a place where ambition and belonging grow side by side. If you’re curious, collaborative and ready to dive deep into meaningful work, you’ll fit right in.

Job Description

We are on the lookout for a Senior Specialist, Product Operations - Logistics Service to join the Product Performance team on our journey to always deliver amazing experiences.

In our Logistics Team, you’ll tackle high-impact challenges that make last-mile delivery efficient, affordable, and sustainable. Your work will directly improve experiences for riders, end customers, and merchants across the globe. Each enhancement you contribute will help Delivery Hero optimize delivery operations, supporting expansion into new areas like grocery and retail.

Our Service Product line is responsible for all customer support-related products, including our in-house agent-facing tools for customer issue resolution, our self-service engine and our global compensation application. Within the Product line, you will be responsible for the performance of our products and work very closely with our product, analytics and data science teams and different entities across the globe to optimize them in order to maximize the value (both cost and top-line) to the business.

- Contribute to improving customer retention and resolving post-delivery issues, with a focus on optimizing self-service experiences
- Run analyses on customer behavior, product usage, and issue resolution patterns to identify opportunities that increase retention, improve experience, and reduce operational costs
- Collaborate closely with product managers, analytics teams, and data scientists to design and evaluate A/B tests and build actionable insights
- Monitor and report on key performance indicators related to retention and post-delivery, ensuring data is accurate, timely, and relevant
- Support regional and local teams by delivering targeted insights, dashboards, and recommendations within your area of specialization
- Identify and communicate areas for product and process enhancements, contributing to prioritization discussions with cross-functional teams
- Contribute to regular reporting and insights for stakeholders and leadership, highlighting both impact and opportunities for efficiency gains

Qualifications

- 4+ years of relevant experience (not counting internships) in a consulting or tech company, working in functions like product operations, user retention, pricing or revenue management
- You have at least a Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative subject - e.g. computer science, physics, mathematics, engineering, social sciences, psychology
- Very strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to draw insights from complex data sets
- You are self-driven and communicative, independent and pragmatic in handling business challenges
- You are proactive, intellectually curious, and motivated by shaping product and business strategy in a high-stakes environment
- Excellent hands on knowledge of reporting tools (Tableau or Looker Studio) & strong hands on knowledge in SQL

Nice to have

- Experience using AI tools in everyday work to bring efficiency and automation
- Experience in a similar large scale tech or e-commerce environment

- selbstständige Vorbereitung, Durchführung und Nachbereitung der Lohn- und Gehaltsabrechnungen für alle Personengruppen – unter Berücksichtigung aktueller arbeits-, lohnsteuer- und sozialversicherungsrechtlicher Vorgaben
- du agierst als kompetente Ansprechperson für unsere Mitarbeitenden bei allen abrechnungs- und bAV relevanten Fragestellungen
- Abwicklung von Pauschalversteuerungen sowie die fachlich korrekte Sicherstellung der steuerlichen Behandlung von, geldwerten Vorteilen, Reisekosten und Veranstaltungen

- du bringst Dich aktiv in die Weiterentwicklung und Standardisierung von Payroll-Prozessen ein und unterstützt die Sicherstellung einheitlicher fachlicher Standards

description:

TECHNICAL DOCUMENTATION WRITER - DEFENSE TECHNOLOGY (F/M)

Contract type Permanent position (Full-time)

Location Erding / Greater Munich Area, Germany (Hybrid)

Reference 2387

Contact

COMPANY PRESENTATION

Our client is an innovative defense technology company developing next-generation solutions that combine advanced sensors, secure communications, and intelligent data processing. Their systems support military and law enforcement operators by providing reliable situational awareness in demanding operational environments.

KEY POINTS OF THE POSITION

* Own the complete technical documentation landscape across multiple projects
* Work closely with engineering, quality, and production teams
* Play a key role in a highly regulated and mission-critical environment
* Drive documentation quality, consistency, and compliance from development through delivery

RESPONSIBILITIES

As a Technical Writer, your responsibilities will include:

* Create and maintain technical datasheets for products, subsystems, and components
* Write user manuals, installation guides, maintenance procedures, and technical documentation
* Ensure documentation remains accurate, structured, version-controlled, and aligned with product evolution
* Gather, review, and organize supplier certificates, test reports, and quality documentation
* Prepare complete documentation packages for customer deliveries, audits, and compliance requirements
* Develop training materials and documentation for internal teams and customers
* Collaborate with engineers to collect, understand, and validate technical information
* Identify documentation gaps, inconsistencies, and risks before they impact projects
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of documentation processes and standards

NECESSARY SKILLS

* Proven experience as a Technical Writer in an industrial or engineering environment
* Strong ability to translate complex technical information into clear and structured documentation
* Experience working with technical specifications, engineering drawings, test reports, and product data
* Familiarity with documentation management, version control, and review processes
* Knowledge of quality standards and regulated environments (ISO 9001 or similar) is highly desirable
* Experience with Jira, Git, or similar documentation/version control tools is a plus
* Background in defense, aerospace, railway, medical devices, electronics, or other critical industries is advantageous
* Flawless German is mandatory
* Professional fluency in English
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to work independently
* Eligibility for German security clearance (SÜ2/Ü2) is required

SALARY

€65,000 - €80,000 gross annual salary, depending on experience, technical expertise, and overall fit.

title: INŽENJER/INŽENJERKA STROJARSTVA
description:
Opis poslova:
  • provedba i nadzor QA/QC planova: izrada, implementacija i praćenje planova kontrole kvalitete (Quality Assurance / Quality Control) u skladu s tehničkom dokumentacijom i važećim normama.
  • kontrola kvalitete i inspekcija: provođenje vizualnih, dimenzionalnih i funkcionalnih inspekcija strojarskih sklopova, zavarenih spojeva, cjevovoda i opreme.
  • nadzor nad NDT ispitivanjima: koordinacija i nadzor nad ispitivanjima bez razaranja (NDT - ultrazvuk, radiografija, penetranti, magnetofluks).
  • upravljanje dokumentacijom: izrada i kontrola popratne QA/QC dokumentacije, testnih izvještaja (ITP - Inspection and Test Plans), atesta materijala i završnih knjiga kvalitete.
  • rješavanje nesukladnosti (NCR): identificiranje odstupanja od projekta ili normi, otvaranje izvještaja o nesukladnosti (NCR), te predlaganje i nadzor korektivnih mjera.
  • suradnja i koordinacija: komunikacija s klijentima, nadzornim inženjerima, proizvodnjom i vanjskim institucijama (inspekcijskim tijelima). Poslodavac na terenu osigurava smještaj i prijevoz. Radnici se u inozemstvu zapošljavaju kao izaslani radnici.

* Kurz gesagt: Wir suchen "Allrounder", die ihr Fachwissen und Können pragmatisch anwenden wollen und Lust auf Karriere haben
* Umsatz und Effizienz ist für uns nicht alles. Wir sind ein Team, daher sollten Sie sich auch bei der Ausbildung der Azubis oder für organisatorische Fragestellungen engagieren wollen

Wir suchen
* Steuerleute mit Qualifikation. Wie alt Sie sind, ist für uns unerheblich. Wir geben Berufseinsteigern genauso eine Chance wie "alten Hasen".
* in Voll- oder Teilzeit (mindestens drei halbe Tage). Die Möglichkeit zu Homeoffice besteht grundsätzlich, allerdings schätzen wir das tägliche Miteinander in der Kanzlei mehr und wollen Sie so bestmöglich in unser Team integrieren
* Auch Quer- oder Wiedereinsteiger sind bei uns willkommen! Wir legen großen Wert auf Aus- und Weiterbildung, daher unterstützen wir Sie gerne beim (Wieder-) Einstieg
* Mitarbeiter mit Engagement, fachlichen Ehrgeiz und Mandantenorientierung
* Mitarbeiter, die in einer inhabergeführten, kleinen Kanzlei kurze Entscheidungswege und offene Türen schätzen, die sich gegenseitig unterstützen und die gerne im Team arbeiten und denken
* Kollegen/-innen mit Berufserfahrung, sicheren Umgang mit Microsoft Office und Datev (z.B. Unternehmen Online, elektronisches Bankbuchen, ...)
* Eigenverantwortung, Qualitätsbewusstsein, Zuverlässigkeit, ausgeprägte Dienstleistungsorientierung und Freude am Umgang mit Menschen, Kollegialität und Teamfähigkeit runden Ihr Profil ab

description:
Erzieher für stationäre Wohngruppe (m/w/d)

Arbeitsort: Berlin und Brandenburg

Für unsere stationären Wohngruppen in Berlin und Brandenburg suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt:

Pädagogische Superhelden:innen und Altagsgestalter:innen mit Herz (all genders) in VZ, TZ, Minijobber

- Eine sinnstiftende Tätigkeit in einem herzlichen und abwechslungsreichen Umfeld

- Flexible Einsatzmöglichkeiten nach Absprache

Schicke deine Bewerbung an Christin Eulau.

description:
Nothing provides more motivation than success. Da Vinci Engineering is highly committed to ensuring the own employees' success. Become a part of us!

Software Project Lead (m/f/d)

Stellen-ID: 22166
Standort: Langen

We are searching intelligent and innovative employees. If you are interested in working for a dynamic company with flat hierarchy, we look forward to receiving your application.

Your tasks:

- Software Project Steering: Lead the end-to-end software development process (A-SPICE compliant) from requirements analysis to final validation and release
- OEM Interface: Serve as the primary technical point of contact for BMW engineering teams. Ensure alignment with BMW-specific release cycles, I-Step management, and integration levels
- Sub-supplier Management: Direct and monitor external software vendors. Define Work Packages (WPs), track KPIs, conduct technical reviews, and ensure their deliverables meet Tier-1 quality standards
- Project Planning: Define software milestones, resource allocation, and risk mitigation strategies. Use Jira/Confluence to maintain a transparent, real-time project pulse
- Quality & Compliance: Ensure software architecture and code adhere to MISRA standards and Functional Safety (ISO 26262) requirements
- Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with Hardware, Systems, and Validation teams to ensure seamless "Big Loop" integration

Your profile:

- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field
- 5+ years in Automotive Software Engineering, 2+ years in a Leadership/Lead role
- Deep familiarity with BMW development processes (e.g., PRISMA, ALM, or specific BMW diagnostic/flash protocols)
- Strong understanding of Embedded Linux, Android Automotive (AAOS), or QNX, knowledge of Adaptive AUTOSAR is a plus
- Fluency in German and English is mandatory for stakeholder management
- Strong negotiation skills for managing sub-suppliers and the ability to thrive under the pressure of SOP deadline

You can expect ...

- Experience in exciting and international projects
- Continuous salary development
- Da Vinci Corporate Benefits
- On-the-job training and language courses
- Appreciation, motivation and commitment

description:
INSBI gGmbH / Institut für soziale und berufliche Integration gGmbH

Wir suchen:
Sozialarbeiter/in, Sozialpädagoge/in, Diplom/BA-Pädagoge/in, Erzieher/in (m/w/d)

Zu uns:
Die INSBI bietet betreutes Wohnen für unbegleitete minderjährige Flüchtlinge (UmF) ab 16 Jahren und für junge Volljährige an. Unser Ziel ist es, diesen Menschen einen sicheren und stabilen Lebensraum zu bieten, in dem sie Vertrauen, Orientierung und Perspektiven für ihre Zukunft entwickeln können.

In Zusammenarbeit mit Jugendämtern und Bildungsträgern setzen wir uns für die gesellschaftliche und berufliche Integration junger Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen ein. Unsere Arbeit basiert auf einem ressourcenorientierten Ansatz und folgt dem Prinzip des Empowerments: Wir begleiten die Jugendlichen individuell und stärken sie in ihrer persönlichen und beruflichen Entwicklung.

Besonders für junge Flüchtlinge, die oft traumatische Erlebnisse hinter sich haben, ist eine stabile und vertrauensvolle Beziehung essenziell. Durch unser Bezugsbetreuersystem bieten wir Halt, Orientierung und fördern ihre Selbstständigkeit.

Mit unserer langjährigen Erfahrung in der Jugendhilfe und Flüchtlingshilfe gestalten wir ein Umfeld, das Sicherheit, Schutz und eine realistische Zukunftsperspektive ermöglicht. Dabei legen wir Wert auf interkulturelle Sensibilität, Reflexion und eine enge Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen Akteuren, um den Jugendlichen bestmögliche Chancen zu bieten.

Darum geht's - Ihre Aufgaben
Als pädagogische/r Mitarbeiter/in in der ambulanten Betreuung im Betreuten Wohnen für minderjährige und junge volljährige Flüchtlinge übernehmen Sie unter anderem folgende Aufgaben:

- Anleitung und Unterstützung der jungen Menschen im lebenspraktischen Bereich, im Besonderen der Verselbstständigung in einer eigenen Wohnung oder WG.
- Begleitung und Unterstützung bei der Abklärung asyl- und aufenthaltsrechtlicher Fragen und der Sicherstellung des Lebensunterhalts
- Einzelförderung im schulischen, beruflichen, sozial-emotionalen und gesundheitlichen Bereich sowie Freizeitgestaltung
- Krisenintervention
- Zusammenarbeit mit Jugendämtern, Behörden, Rechtsanwältinnen, Schulen, Ausbilderinnen und Ärzt*innen
- Verwaltungstätigkeiten wie Dokumentation und Aktenführung
- Teilnahme an Teamsitzungen, Teamsupervision und Weiterbildungen.

Das bringen Sie mit - Ihr Profil

- Sie verfügen über eine Ausbildung/ein Studium zum/zur Sozialpädagoge/in oder Sozialarbeiter/in, Diplom/BA Pädagoge/in oder Erzieher/in oder sind Werksstudent/in und haben Freude an der Begleitung junger Menschen.
- Erfahrung in der pädagogischen Arbeit.
- Fähigkeit zur professionellen Beziehungsarbeit und die Bereitschaft zur kultursensiblen Arbeit.
- Kreativität, Flexibilität und Kooperationsfähigkeit.
- Freude an eigenständiger Arbeitsweise.

Unser Angebot - Ihre Vorteile

- Ein unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag mit einer attraktiven Vergütung, die sich an der Berufsausbildung und der beruflichen Vorerfahrung orientiert.
- Attraktives Gleitzeitangebot.
- Fortlaufende Fachberatung und Supervision sowie Weiterbildungen.
- Einarbeitung durch erfahrene Kollegen.
- Ein engagiertes Team.
- Familienfreundliches Arbeitsumfeld.

- Grundqualifikation: Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Pflegefachkraft (z. B. Gesundheits- und Krankenpfleger/in, Altenpfleger/in).
- Zusatzqualifikation PDL (bei Anstellung oder durch Qualifikation im Rahmen der Beschäftigung): Anerguckte Weiterbildung zur Pflegedienstleitung oder ein entsprechendes Studium.
- Führungstalent: Strukturierte Arbeitsweise, Organisationsgeschick und ein kooperativer Führungsstil.
- Führerschein: Führerschein der Klasse B ist für die ambulante Arbeit notwendig.

Wir bieten Ihnen

- Eine ausfüllende Tätigkeit, bei der Sie sich für Ihre Mitmenschen einsetzen können.
- Eine unbefristete Festanstellung in Vollzeit oder Teilzeit (mindestens 30 Std.).
- Arbeitszeiten, die sich nach Absprache an Ihrer Lebenssituation orientieren. Maximal eine 5-Tage-Woche, nach Absprache auch weniger.
- Verzicht auf Schichtarbeit.
- Eine leistungsgerechte Entlohnung.
- Prämien, Boni und geldwerte Leistungen (Notebook, Handy) in Absprache.
- Die Möglichkeit eines Dienstrads, E-Bikes oder Dienstwagens, in Absprache auch zur privaten Nutzung.
- Eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge.
- Fortbildungsangebote.
- Freiheiten, sich einzubringen und eigene Ideen umzusetzen.
- Innerbetriebliche Entwicklungs- und Aufstiegschancen.
- Ein kollegiales Miteinander und ein nettes Team.

Ihre Bewerbung:

Ihre Bewerbung werden wir vertraulich behandeln.
Ihre Bewerbung senden Sie bitte ausschließlich per E-Mail an: bewerbung@nwnc.de

Bitte nennen Sie uns mit Ihrer Bewerbung den gewünschten zeitlichen Umfang Ihrer Tätigkeit, Ihre Gehaltsvorstellung (brutto) und den bevorzugten Standort für den Sie sich bewerben.

Bitte senden Sie uns mit Ihrer Bewerbung ein Anschreiben, einen Lebenslauf und einen vollständig ausgefüllten Bewerbungsbogen zu. Den Bewerbungsbogen können Sie hier herunterladen: http://nwnc.de/wp-content/uploads/Bewerbungsbogen.pdf

title: Managementassistenz / Kaufmännische Fachkraft / Assistenz der Geschäftsleitung / Sozialmanagement (Managementassistent/in)
description:
Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir zur Unterstützung der Tätigkeit des operativen Tagesgeschäfts der Geschäftsleitung eine engagierte, fachlich versierte Unterstützung. Sie übernehmen koordinative Aufgaben, sind Ansprechpartner in betrieblichen Belangen und sorgen als unverzichtbare "rechte Hand" für die notwendige Entlastung.

Unsere Unternehmen unterhalten an diversen Standorten in Südniederachsen Hilfsangebote für Menschen, die ihren Alltagsverpflichtungen aus eigener Kraft vorübergehend nicht nachkommen können. Zweck der Gesellschaften ist die selbstlose Unterstützung von Personen, die in schwierigen Lebenslagen auf die Hilfe anderer angewiesen sind. Zur Verwirklichung dieses Zwecks erbringen wir Leistungen der Eingliederungshilfe, Hilfe in besonderen Lebenslagen, Schuldnerberatung und unterhalten Beschäftigungsprojekte. Wir unterstützen Menschen zur Sicherung des Lebensunterhalts und zur Befriedigung der Grundbedürfnisse (z.B. Nahrung, Kleidung, Bildung, Ausübung einer Tätigkeit, Mobilität, Freizeitgestaltung) und vermieten Wohnraum.

Wenn Sie sich auf eine Anstellung bewerben, besitzen Sie eine Ausbildung im Bereich Büro oder Verwaltung oder haben ein Studium abgeschlossen, welches Sie befähigt in diesen Bereichen zu arbeiten. Idealer Weise haben Sie durch eine vorherige Beschäftigung bereits fundierte Kenntnisse in den Bereichen Büroorganisation und -management erlangt und könnten nach Absprache selbständig Korrespondenz vorbereiten und führen. Zusätzliche Kenntnisse im Bereich Personal bzw. Buchhaltung wären von Vorteil.

Der zeitliche Umfang Ihrer Stelle erfolgt nach Vereinbarung. Der Stellenumfang sollte mindestens 30 Stunden/ Woche betragen. Ihre Zeiteinteilung ist, nach Absprache und zu vereinbarenden Präsenzzeiten flexibel.

Wir bieten Ihnen

- eine vielseitige Aufgabe in einer zukunftssicheren, wachsenden Unternehmensgruppe
- ein unbefristetes Beschäftigungsverhältnis in Vollzeit oder Teilzeit
- flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle
- einen angenehmen, modernen Arbeitsplatz
- die Möglichkeit eigene Ideen einzubringen und eigenständig zu arbeiten
- flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege
- eine angemessene Entlohnung, betriebliche Altersvorsorge und Jahressonderzahlungen
- nach Absprache die Übernahme von Kindesbetreuungskosten
- innerbetriebliche Entwicklungs-, Aufstiegschancen und Fortbildungsmöglichkeiten
- im Laufe des Beschäftigungsverhältnisses Boni und Leistungsanreize durch die private Nutzung eines Dienstfahrrades, Dienstwagens, Diensthandys bzw. Dienstnotebooks
- einen kollegialen Umgang in einem netten Team.

Wir erwarten:

- Leistungsbereitschaft und -fähigkeit
- Zuverlässigkeit, Flexibilität und Belastbarkeit
- eine schnelle Auffassungsgabe und positive Grundhaltung
- sicheres Deutsch in Wort und Schrift
- einen geschulten Umgang mit Word und Excel, mit PCs und sichere Kenntnisse der Internetrecherche und dem Versand von E-Mails und Kurznachrichten
- Loyalität und Verschwiegenheit.

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung!

Ihre Bewerbung werden wir vertraulich behandeln.

Mit der Bewerbung senden Sie uns bitte ein Anschreiben, einen Lebenslauf, Ihre Zeugnisse und einen Bewerbungsbogen (Link: https://nwnc.de/wp-content/uploads/Bewerbungsbogen_brutto.pdf), in welchem Sie uns Ihre Gehaltsvorstellung, den gewünschten zeitlichen Umfang Ihrer Tätigkeit und gewünschten Beginn Ihrer Tätigkeit nennen.

Ihre Bewerbung senden Sie bitte ausschließlich per E-Mail an: bewerbung@nwnc.de (https://mailto:bewerbung@nwnc.de)

Vielen Dank.

title: Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) (Arbeitsplanungsingenieur/in)
description:
Our Operations Team of OSI Food Solutions searches a Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) in either Toledo, Spain/ Bábolna, Hungary or Ostróda, Poland.

What your job includes

- Coordinating and analyzing the overall EU volume flow for assigned areas, ensuring smooth planning and alignment across sites
- Managing end-to-end volume planning, including demand adjustments, allocation, promotional volumes, and volume transfers between EU plants
- Working with planning tools (Excel, SAP, SAP IBP), preparing scenarios, monitoring deviations and supporting continuous improvement
- Collaborating closely with local EU sites, sales, supply chain, finance, and logistics partners to maintain accurate and efficient planning processes
- Supporting stock management, analyzing demand trends, production and delivery performance and contributing to corrective actions
- Preparing reports on planning adherence, stock trends and demand evolution
- Participating in planning projects and supporting the annual budget allocation process
- Engaging in SAP / SAP IBP implementation, helping shape systems and processes

What we expect from you

- Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Data Analysis, or a similar field
- Experience in a complex supply chain manufacturing environment and in a coordination role involving planning, stock management or forecasting
- Analytical mindset with confidence in building and maintaining data analysis structures
- Autonomy in decision-making
- Strong communication and presentation skills
- Proactive approach to process improvements and openness to change
- Experience with SAP is a significant advantage
- Very good English (written and verbal); additional local language skills are beneficial

What we offer you

We are a company with flat hierarchies, value-based corporate culture and a pronounced customer orientation in a special market. We know that the commitment of our employees is the basis of our success. We therefore support you by quickly giving you responsibility and developing you according to your talents.

Other benefits depending on the location

title: Csoportkoordinátor- Külső csomagolási projektek (Leiter/in - Logistik)
description:
Bevezetés

Részt venni a változás alakításában. Egy lépéssel megelőzni a holnap kihívásait már ma. Együtt növekedni egy fejlődő iparágban. Értékeink mentén, felelősen viselkedni. TÚLLÉPNI A HATÁROKAT. Ezt jelenti a DEUFOL csapatában dolgozni.
Világszerte 3 kontinensen, 12 ország 90 telephelyén, 2400 motivált munkatársunkkal, globális szereplők vagyunk az ellátási lánc megoldások és az ipari csomagolás területén.

Milyen feladatokra számíthatsz?

- Külső (a Deufol Hungary telephelyén kívül megvalósítandó) csomagolási és logisztikai projektek megvalósításának menedzsmentje az üzleti partnereink telephelyein (Debrecenen belül, illetve kívül, több változó helyszínen a régióban), a munkavállalók és a szakmai feladatok koordinálása
- A különféle külső helyszíneken az ipari termékek szakszerű, a megrendelésben meghatározott specifikációknak megfelelő csomagolásának, valamint a lecsomagolt termékek adminisztrációs, anyagmozgatási feladatainak biztosítása, a tevékenységek koordinálása
- Az ügyfélelégedettség biztosítása a külső csomagolási projektek során: egyeztetés a helyi kapcsolattartóval a helyszínen elvégzendő feladatokról, prioritásokról, reklamációs esetek kivizsgálása és részvétel a reakciós folyamatban.
- A külső csomagolási tevékenységekhez felhasznált csomagolóanyagok helyszínre történő kiszállítása céges autóval, szükség esetén fuvarszervezés
- A csapat tevékenységéhez kapcsolódó dokumentációs, riportolási és adminisztrációs feladatok ellátása a csoportvezető felé
- Együttműködés a cégen belüli társterületekkel, illetve a külső partnerekkel

Hozzád illik a pozíció, ha:

- Magabiztos, releváns tapasztalattal rendelkezel kisebb, néhány fős csapat vezetésében és koordinálásában gyártási, termelési, raktári, logisztikai területen
- Magabiztos számítógép-felhasználói ismeretekkel rendelkezel, gyakorlottan használod a MS Office alkalmazásokat; előny, ha valamilyen logisztikai, vállalatirányítási szoftver használatában van már tapasztalatod
- Legalább középfokú végzettséggel rendelkezel; előny a szakirányú végzettség vagy tapasztalat logisztika, ellátási lánc menedzsment, ipari csomagolási, faipari, raktári területen
- Vállalod a külső helyszíneken történő munkavégzést, a rendszeres kiküldetéseket Magyarországon belül, illetve szükség esetén (várhatóan nagyon ritka esetben) külföldre is - a munkavégzésed helyszíne részben a Deufol Hungary székhelye, részben a különböző partnereink telephelyei lesznek
- Rendelkezel B kategóriás jogosítvánnyal és vezetési tapasztalattal
- Előnyt jelent, ha rendelkezel érvényes targoncavezetői vagy híddaru kezelői jogosítvánnyal
- Terhelhető, rugalmas vagy
- Önálló, felelősségteljes munkavégzés jellemez
- Jó kommunikációs, szervező- és problémamegoldó készséggel rendelkezel
- Pozitív, csapatjátékos és ügyfélközpontú hozzáállásod van
- Alapfokú aktív angol nyelvtudás előny (mindennapi munkahelyi helyzetekben tudod használni, pl. e-mailezés, egyszerű telefonhívások/helyszíni egyeztetések)

Hogyan tudunk inspirálni?

- Stabil cég vagyunk, hosszú távon számíthatsz ránk és mi is hosszú távon gondolkodunk benned
- 180 fős munkavállalói létszámunk biztosítja a közvetlen, támogató közeget, ahol a vezetők is mindig elérhetők
- Innovatív, növekvő nemzetközi vállalati környezetben dolgozhatsz
- Érdekes és felelősségteljes feladatokat végezhetsz, csapatban közösen és a saját tudásod, kreativitásod és személyiséged használva
- Piacnak megfelelő juttatási csomagga

title: Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) (Arbeitsplanungsingenieur/in)
description:
Our Operations Team of OSI Food Solutions searches a Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) in either Toledo, Spain/ Bábolna, Hungary or Ostróda, Poland.

What your job includes

- Coordinating and analyzing the overall EU volume flow for assigned areas, ensuring smooth planning and alignment across sites
- Managing end-to-end volume planning, including demand adjustments, allocation, promotional volumes, and volume transfers between EU plants
- Working with planning tools (Excel, SAP, SAP IBP), preparing scenarios, monitoring deviations and supporting continuous improvement
- Collaborating closely with local EU sites, sales, supply chain, finance, and logistics partners to maintain accurate and efficient planning processes
- Supporting stock management, analyzing demand trends, production and delivery performance and contributing to corrective actions
- Preparing reports on planning adherence, stock trends and demand evolution
- Participating in planning projects and supporting the annual budget allocation process
- Engaging in SAP / SAP IBP implementation, helping shape systems and processes

What we expect from you

- Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Data Analysis, or a similar field
- Experience in a complex supply chain manufacturing environment and in a coordination role involving planning, stock management or forecasting
- Analytical mindset with confidence in building and maintaining data analysis structures
- Autonomy in decision-making
- Strong communication and presentation skills
- Proactive approach to process improvements and openness to change
- Experience with SAP is a significant advantage
- Very good English (written and verbal); additional local language skills are beneficial

What we offer you

We are a company with flat hierarchies, value-based corporate culture and a pronounced customer orientation in a special market. We know that the commitment of our employees is the basis of our success. We therefore support you by quickly giving you responsibility and developing you according to your talents.

Other benefits depending on the location

title: Head Operational Excellence Europe (m/f/d) (Operations Manager/in)
description:
To further strengthen our Operations & Supply Chain organization, we are looking for an experienced Head of Operational Excellence at Group level.

This high-impact role, reporting directly to the COO, offers a unique opportunity to design, build, and implement the Operational Excellence system from the start. You will operate within an international environment with multiple manufacturing sites.

In this initial phase, you will take the lead in developing and rolling out the foundation of our Operational Excellence framework, driving sustainable operational improvements throughout the organization.

Your mission

- In the first phase, your key responsibility will be to: - Design and establish the Group-wide Operational Excellence Production System
- Build the standards, tools and governance needed for sustainable implementation
- Create and roll out structured processes across Production, Logistics and Quality
- Set up performance management (KPI cascade, visual management, gap analysis)
- Develop and initiate the first wave of improvement projects and cost optimization pipeline
- Following this setup phase, you will: - Drive year-on-year efficiency improvements
- Scale and embed Lean & Six Sigma methodologies across all sites
- Act as a change leader, embedding mindset, behavior and capabilities

Your profile

- Master’s degree in engineering with strong analytical and statistical skills
- At least 3 years of leadership experience in a complex operations/manufacturing environment
- Strong track record in building and implementing Operational Excellence frameworks from the ground up
- Deep expertise in Lean / Six Sigma (Green/Black Belt preferred)
- Structured, hands-on and capable of turning concepts into execution
- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
- Willingness to travel across Europe (25–50%)
- Fluent in English and preferably German

Benefits

- **Work-life balance:** We offer flexible working hours in a hybrid work environment
- **Time off & flexibility:** With 30 days of vacation per year and flexible scheduling
- **Quick decision-making & autonomy:** You’ll benefit from quick decision-making and plenty of freedom to pursue your own ideas and creative solutions
- **Motivated team & international environment:** Work in a dedicated team with colleagues from different countries and cultures
- Individual management coaching: We support your personal and professional development through individual coaching
- **Exciting tasks:** Look forward to varied responsibilities in a sustainable and innovative company
- **Comprehensive benefits:** Enjoy advantages such as capital-forming benefits, TicketPlus, Hansefit and exclusive discounts

Your next step - get in touch!

We welcome your application, including details of your salary expectations and your earliest possible start date. For initial contact, please reach out to Roman Heizmann, Recruiting Manager.

title: Assistant driller
description:
Seeking an assistant driller

Iceland Drilling Company (IDC) is an international leader in geothermal drilling, committed to providing safe and efficient drilling solutions with a focus on sustainability. We take pride in operating advanced, automatic drilling rigs that create a safe and positive working environment for our highly motivated crew members.

Key Responsibilities:
• Responsibility for correct mud tank settings, mixing mud and mud additives, measurement of specific gravity and viscosity of mud, monitior and cleaning mud pumps and pits.
• Trip in – lubricating threads and assisting with drill string assembly and removal of drill string.
• Receipt, measurement and cleaning of casings, assisting with casing assembly.
• Installation and arrangement of BOP‘s.
• Assisting with cementing.
• Reception and clearing up of drilling equipment (drill bits, stabilizers, jars, mud motors, MWD‘s etc).
• Substitute for driller/assistant driller as needed.

Qualifications & Requirements:
• Experience within geothermal drilling is preferred. Experience with Drillmec or Bentec rigs strongly preferred. Experince as Derrickman. 2 years minimum Assistant Driller experience highly preferred.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Strong problem-solving and initiative, fluency in English. Good experince operating powertools.
• Valid driver's license. Icelandic forklift license (preferred). IWCF license, level 1-2 preferred. Forklift license for 10 tons + preferred.
• Proactive approach to hazard identification and control. Ability to work effectively in remote and demanding environments. Ability to work under pressure and in challenging environments.
• Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to make quick decisions.
• Safety-conscious with a commitment to maintaining high safety standard.

Employer can assist with housing.

Full time job – shift work; work arrangements vary depending on the project.
Wages according to collective agreements with Framsýn workers union.

Please apply by sending your application and CV to: jons@jardboranir.is.
Last application date is October 31, 2026.

title: Erä- ja luonto opas tai muu luontomatkailualan ammattilainen
description:
**Etsin lisää luontomatkailualan ammattilaisia yhteistyöhön kanssani ja osaksi yritykseni Wild Adventures North kasvutarinaa.**

Wild Adventures North on erikoistunut järjestämään villejä seikkailuja suomalaiselle kohderyhmälle. Tarjoamme 10 vuoden kokemuksella autenttisen eräkokemuksen sen kaikessa karuudessaan ja kauneudessaan.

Elämyksiä suunnittelee ja toteuttaa yhteistyössä alan ammattilaisista koostuva tiimi. Toiminta-alueemme kattaa Suomen, Ruotsin ja Norjan upeimmat luontokohteet.

Meille luonnossa liikkuminen on enemmän kuin siirtymistä paikasta toiseen - se on oppimista oivaltamista a yhteyttä ympäröivään luontoon, Opetamme asiakkaalle kaiken, mitä hän tarvitsee - ja vähän enemmänkin.

Tarjontamme on omassa kategoriassaan Suomen laajin: valikoimaamme kuuluu jo 69 erilaista patikka- hiihto-, melonta-, juoksu-, lumikenkä- ja jäätikkövaellusta sekä selviytymiskoulutusta. Meidän kanssamme asiakas voi esimerkiksi:

- vaeltaa koko Suomen Lapin halki kaikkien 12 erämaan läpi

- nousta Suomen korkeimmalle tunturille - ja huiputtaa pikavaellustyylillä kaikki Suomen 33 yli 1000-metristä tunturia

- saavuttaa Suomen ja Ruotsin erämaisimmat pisteet meloa packraftilla niin sileässä vedessä kuin kuohuvissa koskissakin suorittaa Suomen vaativimman kaupallisen selviytymiskokeen, jossa hänet eksytetään helikopterilla viikoksi erämaahan ilman ruokaa, telttaa ja makuupussia - ja käydä ensin siihen valmistavan koulutuspolun

- vaeltaa Pohjois-Norjan jäätikköerämaassa köysistössä, jääraudat jalassa ja hakku kädessä


Yritykseni lähivuosien tavoitteena on laajentaa;

- toiminta uusiin maihin

- markkinointi suomalaisille yrityksille ja lapsiperheille

- elämystarjonta uusiin lajeihin


Jos sinulla on kompetenssia ja ideaa tarttua johonkin näistä kolmesta tavoitteesta, saatat olla etsimäni ammattilainen.

Yhteistyö kanssani tarkoittaa sitä, että olemme yhdessä laatineet välillemme yhteistyösopimuksen, joka mm. määrittelee roolit, tehtävät, vastuun ja potin iaon. Olet yrittäjä, joka laskuttaa yritystäni palveluistaan.

Yhteistyössä kanssani on eri tasoja. Voit olla vieraileva opas, joka tekee yhden tai useamman yksittäisen keikan. Tai voit olla kiinteä osa brändini suojeluksessa toimivaa opastiimiä, joka suunnittelee, testaa ja toteuttaa uusia elämyksiä

Yhteistyö kanssani on kannattavaa, jos et halua rakentaa uutta luontomatkailubisnestä tyhjästä. Pääset hyötymään yritykseni 10 vuoden ajan rakennetusta laajasta asiakaspoolista, näkyvyydestä, vakiintuneesta markkina-asemasta, ryhmäkalustosta ja tiimin vertaistuesta.

Odotan yhteydenottoasi!

description:

title: Erä- ja luonto opas tai muu luontomatkailualan ammattilainen
description:
**Etsin lisää luontomatkailualan ammattilaisia yhteistyöhön kanssani ja osaksi yritykseni Wild Adventures North kasvutarinaa.**

Wild Adventures North on erikoistunut järjestämään villejä seikkailuja suomalaiselle kohderyhmälle. Tarjoamme 10 vuoden kokemuksella autenttisen eräkokemuksen sen kaikessa karuudessaan ja kauneudessaan.

Elämyksiä suunnittelee ja toteuttaa yhteistyössä alan ammattilaisista koostuva tiimi. Toiminta-alueemme kattaa Suomen, Ruotsin ja Norjan upeimmat luontokohteet.

Meille luonnossa liikkuminen on enemmän kuin siirtymistä paikasta toiseen - se on oppimista oivaltamista a yhteyttä ympäröivään luontoon, Opetamme asiakkaalle kaiken, mitä hän tarvitsee - ja vähän enemmänkin.

Tarjontamme on omassa kategoriassaan Suomen laajin: valikoimaamme kuuluu jo 69 erilaista patikka- hiihto-, melonta-, juoksu-, lumikenkä- ja jäätikkövaellusta sekä selviytymiskoulutusta. Meidän kanssamme asiakas voi esimerkiksi:

- vaeltaa koko Suomen Lapin halki kaikkien 12 erämaan läpi

- nousta Suomen korkeimmalle tunturille - ja huiputtaa pikavaellustyylillä kaikki Suomen 33 yli 1000-metristä tunturia

- saavuttaa Suomen ja Ruotsin erämaisimmat pisteet meloa packraftilla niin sileässä vedessä kuin kuohuvissa koskissakin suorittaa Suomen vaativimman kaupallisen selviytymiskokeen, jossa hänet eksytetään helikopterilla viikoksi erämaahan ilman ruokaa, telttaa ja makuupussia - ja käydä ensin siihen valmistavan koulutuspolun

- vaeltaa Pohjois-Norjan jäätikköerämaassa köysistössä, jääraudat jalassa ja hakku kädessä


Yritykseni lähivuosien tavoitteena on laajentaa;

- toiminta uusiin maihin

- markkinointi suomalaisille yrityksille ja lapsiperheille

- elämystarjonta uusiin lajeihin


Jos sinulla on kompetenssia ja ideaa tarttua johonkin näistä kolmesta tavoitteesta, saatat olla etsimäni ammattilainen.

Yhteistyö kanssani tarkoittaa sitä, että olemme yhdessä laatineet välillemme yhteistyösopimuksen, joka mm. määrittelee roolit, tehtävät, vastuun ja potin iaon. Olet yrittäjä, joka laskuttaa yritystäni palveluistaan.

Yhteistyössä kanssani on eri tasoja. Voit olla vieraileva opas, joka tekee yhden tai useamman yksittäisen keikan. Tai voit olla kiinteä osa brändini suojeluksessa toimivaa opastiimiä, joka suunnittelee, testaa ja toteuttaa uusia elämyksiä

Yhteistyö kanssani on kannattavaa, jos et halua rakentaa uutta luontomatkailubisnestä tyhjästä. Pääset hyötymään yritykseni 10 vuoden ajan rakennetusta laajasta asiakaspoolista, näkyvyydestä, vakiintuneesta markkina-asemasta, ryhmäkalustosta ja tiimin vertaistuesta.

Odotan yhteydenottoasi!

description:

Chef Manager Location: Ringaskiddy, Co. Cork Salary: €50,000 per annum Contract: Permanent, Full Time About the Role We are looking for an experienced and passionate Chef Manager to lead our catering operation at Pfizer Ringaskiddy. This is a hands-on leadership role for a chef who takes pride in delivering high-quality food, exceptional service and consistently high standards. You will lead and support the kitchen team, oversee the full food cycle from delivery through to service, and ensure that catering services are delivered safely, efficiently and to the required client standards. You will also play a key role in supporting the day-to-day operation of the unit and deputising for the Business Manager when required. Key Responsibilities Lead and manage the kitchen team to deliver excellent food and service. Plan weekly menus and ensure all food and supply requirements are ordered on time. Maintain the highest standards of food quality, hygiene, preparation, presentation and service. Ensure allergen and HACCP documentation is completed accurately and on time. Manage food costs, labour costs and expenditure within agreed budgets. Ensure stock is correctly stored, organised and rotated. Drive the daily use of the Leanpath Waste Management System and actively reduce food waste. Ensure all food preparation and production complies with company standards and procedures. Maintain compliance with Health & Safety, hygiene, fire, COSHH and site requirements. Monitor equipment to ensure it is safe, maintained and fit for use. Support continuous improvement and identify opportunities to enhance the catering service. Build and maintain excellent relationships with clients and customers. Respond professionally to customer feedback, compliments and complaints. Support recruitment, induction, training, development and performance management of the kitchen team. Lead regular team briefings and ensure staff maintain a positive, friendly and professional approach. Support the achievement of service level agreements, KPIs, audit standards and client satisfaction targets. What We're Looking For We're looking for a confident and commercially aware Head Chef with proven experience leading a kitchen team. You will ideally have: Proven experience managing and leading a kitchen team. Strong knowledge of the catering industry and awareness of current developments and innovations. Excellent budgeting and financial management skills. Experience working within a standards-driven or compliance-focused environment. A strong customer-service mindset. Excellent communication and negotiation skills. Creativity, personal innovation and a genuine passion for food. Experience implementing and driving company initiatives. Relevant culinary qualifications and training. Sodexo reserves the right to close this advert early if we are in receipt of a high number of applications.

description:

Who We Are: A small but dynamic business based in Dundalk. Irish Whiskey Auctions is Irelands largest whiskey auction house and shipping hub. Role Summary Irish Whiskey Auctions is looking for a Whiskey & Auction Operations Coordinator to join our team in Dundalk. This is a varied, hands-on role that combines whiskey knowledge, auction and office administration, customer service, logistics and shipping. It would suit someone who enjoys variety in their working day and week, is practical and organised, and is happy to get involved in various aspects of the business. The Role Working as part of our team, you will be involved in the day-to-day operation of our whiskey auctions, including: • Assisting with the administration and running of our whiskey auctions • Receiving and processing whiskey and spirits consignments • Assisting with collections and deliveries using a company van • Preparing items for auction and ensuring accurate records are maintained • Coordinating with couriers and shipping providers • Dealing with customers enquiries by email, phone and in person • Assisting with international and domestic shipments • Stock control • Supporting the wider team with general auction and office administration • Ensuring customers receive a high level of customer service • Working flexibly across different areas of the business as required Key Requirements:- • A full clean driving licence • Countrywide collections using company van. • Good organisational and administrative skills • Excellent attention to detail • Good communication and customer service skills • Good computer skills and the ability to learn new systems • A practical, hands-on approach to work • The ability to work independently while also being a strong team player • A willingness to take on different tasks and adapt as priorities change Existing whiskey knowledge is highly desirable but training will be provided. Knowledge of Irish whiskey, spirits, the drinks industry, logistics, shipping or online auctions would be an advantage. Benefits:- • Competitive Salary • Company pension on completion of probation period • Employee discount • Specialist training where required • Company events To apply: Please send your CV and a short introduction outlining your relevant experience and why the role interests you.

title: tecnico della gestione post vendita
description: Per azienda cliente leader nel settore impermeabilizzazione di strutture selezioniamo: TECNICO COMMERCIALE AREA EMILIA_AMBITO CIVILE/EDILE Di cosa ti occuperai? Inserito/a nella rete commerciale e lavorando a stretto contatto con Area Manager e agenti di zona, sarai un punto di riferimento tecnico per progettisti, imprese e installatori, con un ruolo dinamico tra ufficio e cantiere. In particolare, sarai specialista nel fornire soluzioni tecnico-commerciali presso clientela B2B (studi di progettazione, imprese, installatori e distributori): - supporterai il team commerciale nella definizione della proposta tecnica e tramite sopralluoghi operativi in cantiere - gestirai incontri tecnici e formativi rivolti a progettisti e installatori per diffondere competenze applicative e qualità esecutiva - implementerai nuove relazioni sul territorio e contribuirai all'inserimento delle soluzioni nei capitolati Hai queste competenze e caratteristiche? - formazione in ambito edile/civile (Ingegneria Edile/Civile, Architettura/Geometra) - esperienza in ruoli tecnico-commerciali nel settore edile (o contesti affini) - dimestichezza con AutoCAD e Office 365 - conoscenza della lingua inglese intermedia - ottime capacità comunicative e relazionali, orientamento agli obiettivi e curiosità professionale - disponibilità a trasferte sul territorio (ruolo in mobilità nell'area Emilia Romagna) Orario di lavoro: full time, dal lunedì al venerdì (attività prevalentemente sul territorio con flessibilità operativa e possibilità di smart working). Offerta Contrattuale: Inserimento con contratto di assunzione diretta a tempo indeterminato per figure middle/senior nel ruolo, mentre con risorse entry level è previsto un apprendistato professionalizzante finalizzato all'indeterminato CCNL applicato: Industria calce, cemento e gesso La retribuzione prevista è compresa tra € 35.000 e € 36.000 lordi annui, definita in base all'inquadramento contrattuale, alle mansioni previste e alle caratteristiche della posizione. Sono inoltre previsti auto ad uso promiscuo, PC e telefono aziendale, incentivi legati ai risultati. Prevista formazione iniziale con training 1-2 settimane presso l'HQ in provincia di Treviso. Luogo di lavoro: Emilia-Romagna (ruolo in mobilità: smart working + presidio presso Clienti e cantieri nell'area) - base preferibile Bologna Se pensi di avere le competenze e l'attitudine per questo ruolo, inviaci la tua candidatura! *Grafton Engineering è una specializzazione di Gi Group Spa autorizzata ad operare dal Ministero del Lavoro e delle Politiche Sociali (Aut. title: collaudatore di circuiti stampati/collaudatrice di circuiti stampati
description: Sei un giovane Diplomato a cui piacerebbe lavorare in un contesto dinamico e attento alla formazione delle risorse? Questa è l'opportunità giusta per TE! Gi Pro Mechanics 4.0 è la specializzazione di Gi Group dedicata a valorizzare le esperienze, le competenze e il potenziale dei candidati in ambito meccanico, meccatronico ed elettromeccanico, in partnership con Rotolito SpA, storica azienda italiana che opera nel settore della carta stampata e leader nelle arti grafiche, cerca persone motivate a iniziare un nuovo percorso formativo-lavorativo (IFTS) progettato in collaborazione con l'Istituto Formazione Operatori Aziendali (IFOA) da inserire come ADDETTA/O MANUTENZIONE MACCHINE STAMPA Il ruolo ha lo scopo di prevenire e riparare i guasti dei macchinari tipografici o industriali. Garantisce il corretto funzionamento della linea produttiva, riducendo al minimo i tempi di fermo macchina e assicurando la qualità del prodotto stampato. Di cosa si tratta? Sarai assunto/a con un Contratto di Apprendistato di 1° Livello, che ti permetterà di acquisire competenze orientate all'innovazione tecnologica in ambito: - Tecnologie dei processi di produzione (Processi grafici, materie prime, macchine, attrezzature); - Controllo qualità del prodotto; - Certificazioni di processo; - Logistica industriale; che verranno certificate attraverso il rilascio di un titolo di studio (Certificato di Specializzazione Tecnica Superiore) subito spendibile nel mercato del lavoro italiano ed europeo. Quali sono i vantaggi di questo percorso? Formazione teorica e pratica fornita da esperti del settore; Opportunità di apprendere e lavorare in un ambiente stimolante e innovativo; Possibilità di assunzione stabile presso l'azienda al completamento del percorso formativo previa valutazione positiva del percorso; La ricerca è rivolta a Candidati/e di età compresa tra 18-24 anni, in possesso di Diploma di Istruzione Secondaria Superiore Superiore o del quarto anno di IeFP di tipo Tecnico. Si offre inserimento con contratto di Apprendistato di 1° Livello in somministrazione di circa 9 mesi, in partenza a novembre, finalizzato ad una stabilizzazione a lungo termine. CCNL applicato: Grafica Industria Livello di inquadramento: D1 (€1.703, 76 lordi mensili) Retribuzione: Formazione Esterna (300 ore): Non Retribuita Formazione Interna (500 ore): 50% rispetto al Livello di inserimento previsto (€ 4,91 lordi orari) Ore Lavoro (Ca. 200 ore): 70% rispetto al Livello di inserimento previsto (€ 6,88 lordi orari) Luogo di lavoro: Cernusco sul Naviglio (MI) Se sei interessato/a a partecipare a questo percorso presenta la tua candidatura e, in presenza dei requisiti richiesti, sarai ricontattato da un nostro consulente. Cosa aspetti? Non perdere l'opportunità di partecipare al percorso e iniziare a fare la differenza nel settore della grafica! title: consulente di ricerca e selezione del personale
description: Gi Group SpA, prima Agenzia per il Lavoro Italiana ricerca per la propria divisione Gi EDU: FORMATORE / FORMATRICE SENIOR IL RUOLO Il/la professionista si occuperà della formazione dedicata ai DOCENTI di un istituto superiore di secondo grado, avrà la responsabilità di progettare e realizzare il percorso formativo, traducendo gli obiettivi didattici in contenuti, strumenti e attività immediatamente spendibili nella pratica scolastica. Svolgerà le seguenti attività: - Progettazione del percorso formativo in coerenza con gli obiettivi e i bisogni della scuola; - predisposizione dei materiali didattici e delle esercitazioni; - erogazione della formazione in presenza e/o da remoto, secondo il cronoprogramma concordato; - gestione di attività laboratoriali, casi e momenti di confronto con i docenti; - collaborazione al monitoraggio in itinere dell'andamento e degli esiti della formazione. Cerchiamo un/una professionista capace di coniugare competenza specialistica, concretezza e capacità di coinvolgere i docenti, trasformando la formazione in strumenti realmente applicabili in classe. REQUISITI RICHIESTI: - percorso di studi coerente con le tematiche della formazione; preferibile Laurea in Psicologia, Pedagogia o Sociologia; - conoscenza approfondita di BES, DSA e didattica inclusiva; - esperienza nella formazione di gruppi di adulti; costituisce titolo preferenziale l'esperienza nel mondo della scuola e nella formazione del personale docente; - capacità di progettare materiali, esercitazioni e strumenti operativi per i docenti; - ottime capacità relazionali, comunicative ed empatiche, organizzazione e attitudine al lavoro in team. CONDIZIONI DELLA COLLABORAZIONE Tipologia contrattuale: collaborazione con PARTITA IVA Compenso: 40,00 € all'ora, IVA inclusa Orario: nella fascia oraria pomeridiana, orario da definire in accordo con la disponibilità della risorsa e le esigenze della scuola. Il progetto sarà erogato in 60 ore circa da pianificare in due macro moduli. SEDE Luogo di lavoro: Anagni (FR). title: segretario/segretaria
description: On behalf of the Italian Entrepreneurial Holding of a growing international Group, we are looking for a Consolidation & Reporting Manager. Reporting directly to the Corporate Finance Manager, this is a stand-alone role. The successful candidate will actively contribute to building Group accounting processes and must possess comprehensive knowledge of IFRS principles. Key Responsibilities Preparation of monthly and annual consolidated financial statements, including adjusting and consolidation entries. Reconciliation of intercompany accounts and elimination entries, including the investigation and resolution of reconciliation variances. Translation of foreign subsidiaries' financial statements and management of foreign exchange differences. Management of changes in the consolidation scope, including acquisitions, mergers, takeovers, and corporate reorganizations. Support in accounting for Purchase Price Allocation (PPA), goodwill, and consolidation differences, where applicable. Preparation of reporting packages and accounting instructions for Group companies. Analysis of data submitted by subsidiaries, ensuring completeness, accuracy, and consistency, and managing detailed follow-up requests. Support in preparing the consolidated Notes to the Financial Statements and documentation for auditors and corporate governance bodies. Liaison with the Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) team to ensure consistency between management reporting and consolidated financial data. Liaison with the administrative teams of foreign subsidiaries, providing support for accounting and administrative activities. Requirements Degree in Economics, Accounting, Finance, or a related field. 5+ years of experience in Group Consolidation, Financial Reporting, External Audit, or Corporate Accounting. Previous experience within multinational listed companies or top-tier audit and advisory firms. Strong knowledge of IAS/IFRS Proven ability to manage complex reporting activities under tight deadlines Fluent English, both written and spoken, used regularly in a professional environment. Knowledge of USGAAP and experience with Oracle are a plus Offer Permanent employment Contract RAL between €50,000 and €60,000 1 day of remote working per week #LI-AM2

Per conto di una realtà investigativa strutturata e specializzata nel contrasto alle frodi civili e penali a tutela delle compagnie assicurative, ricerchiamo una figura esperta da inserire nella Divisione Antifrode Assicurativa. Costituiscono titolo preferenziale formazione in ambito giuridico, economico o criminologico; esperienza nel settore delle indagini antifrode, compliance, audit o investigazioni; conoscenza della normativa e delle principali dinamiche relative alle frodi assicurative; esperienza nella gestione e redazione di documentazione investigativa. Ecco l'opportunità che stavi cercando! L'Academy che ti proponiamo è realizzata in partnership con CRIF Spa, gruppo internazionale specializzato in soluzioni digitali, sistemi decisionali, software e servizi per il settore finanziario, presente in oltre 35 Paesi e attivo nello sviluppo di tecnologie innovative a livello globale. NEOLAUREATI/E in STATISTICA - ACADEMY JUNIOR DATA SCIENTIST Cerchiamo giovani talenti da formare e inserire come Junior Data Scientist attraverso un percorso di Academy altamente qualificante e totalmente gratuito. Cosa prevede l'Academy: - 4 Settimane di corso virtuale, con data start Lunedì 12 Ottobre 2026; - Lezioni frontali e project work con il supporto di docenti qualificati; - Possibilità di inserimento al termine del percorso tramite contratto a tempo determinato in somministrazione Gi Group; - L'Academy si svolgerà interamente in modalità virtuale; - Corso completamente gratuito per tutti i partecipanti. Che cosa imparerai? Sarai formato/a per ricoprire il ruolo di Junior Data Scientist, sviluppando competenze nell'analisi di grandi volumi di dati e trasformarli in insight utili al business. Lavorerai con Python (anche in ottica OOP) e con strumenti come Pandas e NumPy per preparare, pulire e valorizzare i dataset, fino a realizzare analisi e visualizzazioni efficaci e dashboard. Entrerai poi nel cuore della disciplina costruendo modelli predittivi e di scoring (classificazione e regressione), approfondendo le principali tecniche di feature engineering, clustering, serie storiche e ottimizzazione dei modelli, per coprire l'intero ciclo di vita di un progetto analitico. Completerai il percorso con un'introduzione alla Generative AI, ai LLM e al Prompt Engineering, per comprendere come integrare questi strumenti in soluzioni data-driven anche in contesti progettuali internazionali. Cosa cerchiamo? - Laureandi/Neolaureati/e in Statistica - Conoscenza di base di Python, SQL, R; - Doti analitiche, problem solving, capacità comunicative e motivazione a lavorare in ambito consulenziale - Buona conoscenza della lingua INGLESE. Sede corso: Modalità virtuale; Orario corso: Full-Time da lunedì al venerdì dalle 9:00 alle 18:00. description: Project Manager - Cantieri navali Nuove Costruzioni L'Azienda Il nostro cliente è uno storico cantiere navale genovese con un consolidato know how nella riparazione e costruzione navale. Il ruolo Nell'ambito dello sviluppo del business delle nuove costruzioni, siamo alla ricerca di un Project Manager che segua la realizzazione delle commesse dalla fase di avvio fino alla consegna finale, garantendo il raggiungimento degli obiettivi contrattuali, tecnici, economici, temporali e qualitativi. Opererà come principale punto di riferimento verso Direzione, Cliente e funzioni interne, coordinando in modo strategico e gestionale tutte le attività necessarie alla corretta esecuzione del progetto. Principali responsabilità Gestire l'intero ciclo di vita della commessa di nuova costruzione, dall'avvio alla consegna finale dell'unità. Pianificare e monitorare il programma generale di commessa, assicurando milestone e scadenze contrattuali. Coordinare funzioni interne e stakeholder (Ufficio Tecnico, Produzione, Procurement, Qualità, HSE, AFC/Controllo di Gestione). Gestire la parte economica della commessa: predisposizione e monitoraggio di budget/forecast, controllo costi, cash flow, analisi scostamenti e azioni correttive a tutela della marginalità. Selezionare e gestire fornitori/subappaltatori/partner: valutazione offerte, controllo prestazioni e gestione criticità/ritardi. Gestire la relazione con Cliente/Armatore/Classifica/Autorità: governance, riunioni di avanzamento, comunicazioni e reporting. Governare aspetti contrattuali e tecnici (varianti, change order, extra work, claim) e assicurare commissioning/HAT/prove in mare, chiusura punch list, non conformità e documentazione finale. Il Profilo Ideale Formazione: Laurea in Ingegneria Navale (valutabili Ingegneria Meccanica/Industriale o titoli equivalenti con consolidata esperienza nel settore). Esperienza: - Consolidata esperienza (almeno 8-10 anni) nel ruolo di Project Manager nel settore navale con un focus sulla costruzione navale o in società del settore marittimo. - Preferibile esperienza presso primari cantieri navali internazionali. - Esperienza su commesse di elevato valore economico e complessità tecnica. Competenze tecniche/gestionali: - Conoscenza dei processi e delle fasi di costruzione navale. - Buona conoscenza di strutture navali, impianti di bordo e discipline tecniche. - Capacità di lettura e interpretazione di specifiche tecniche, contratti, disegni costruttivi e documentazione di commessa. Lingue - Ottimo inglese scritto e parlato (seconda lingua preferenziale). Competenze personali - Leadership su team multidisciplinari e forte orientamento al risultato. - Decision making in contesti complessi, pianificazione e gestione priorità. - Flessibilità e disponibilità a trasferte. title: Database and network professionals
description: Per conto di una realtà tecnologica di grandi dimensioni, operante in un contesto internazionale, siamo alla ricerca di un/una Senior Cyber Security Engineer da inserire all'interno di un team Cyber Security strutturato. La risorsa entrerà a far parte di una funzione tecnica che opera trasversalmente a supporto delle diverse aree IT, Software e Business del Gruppo, contribuendo alla progettazione, evoluzione e miglioramento dei servizi e dei controlli di Cyber Security. Cerchiamo un professionista con una buona seniority tecnica e una visione trasversale della sicurezza, capace di andare oltre la gestione operativa degli incidenti e contribuire all'evoluzione dell'ecosistema Cyber aziendale. Principali responsabilità La persona sarà coinvolta in attività quali: supporto a nuovi progetti IT e Software secondo principi di Security by Design, attraverso security review e definizione dei requisiti di sicurezza; definizione ed evoluzione dei controlli di Cloud Security, principalmente in ambienti Microsoft Azure e AWS; presidio delle tematiche di Identity Security, con particolare riferimento a Microsoft Entra ID e Active Directory; valutazione e scouting di nuove tecnologie e servizi messi a disposizione dai principali cloud e security provider; evoluzione dei servizi di Cyber Security Monitoring, collaborando con il SOC esterno e contribuendo al tuning delle piattaforme SIEM e dei relativi controlli di detection; attività di Vulnerability Management su componenti infrastrutturali e applicative; evoluzione dei presidi di sicurezza relativi a Firewall, WAF, endpoint, infrastrutture e ambienti Cloud; supporto ad attività di Incident Response e miglioramento continuo dei relativi processi e controlli; partecipazione alla definizione di iniziative di Purple Teaming, finalizzate all'identificazione delle aree di miglioramento della postura difensiva; confronto con Software Architect, Service Manager, team IT e Business per integrare i requisiti Cyber all'interno di nuovi servizi e applicazioni; supporto, quando necessario, nel confronto con clienti enterprise sui presidi di sicurezza adottati nei servizi erogati. Profilo ricercato Cerchiamo un professionista con esperienza in ambito Cyber Security Engineering, Cloud Security, Infrastructure Security o Security Architecture, maturata in contesti aziendali strutturati o all'interno di società di consulenza tecnologica. Non è necessario aver maturato esperienza approfondita in tutte le aree indicate. Sarà particolarmente interessante una solida competenza in una o più delle seguenti: Cloud Security in ambienti Azure e/o AWS; Identity & Access Security, Entra ID / Active Directory; Security Engineering e definizione di security controls; Cyber Security Monitoring e tecnologie SIEM/XDR; Vulnerability Management; Infrastructure & Network Security; Application Security / Security by Design. Saranno considerate un plus esperienze in ambito Microsoft Security, Microsoft 365 Security, Incident Response, Purple Teaming e attività di security assessment. È richiesta una buona conoscenza della lingua inglese. Offerta RAL indicativa: €50.000 - €60.000 + MBO, valutabile in funzione dell'esperienza; inserimento diretto a tempo indeterminato; modalità di lavoro ibrida con 2 giorni alla settimana in presenza a Bologna; #LI-AM2

title: COC Master 500GT-3000GT or more than 3000GT (STCW II/2) (Kapitän/in)
description:
The MV Louise Michel is a former French Navy boat we’ve customized to perform search and rescue. Measuring 30 meters in length and capable of up to 28 knots, she was bought with proceeds from the sale of Banksy artwork - who then decorated her with a fire extinguisher. She is operated and crewed by a team of international activist rescue professionals.

- Main responsibilities: handling the ship, overview, control of the vessel and crew safety
- You have the final responsibility for all nautical and technical decisions concerning the operation as well as related crew intructions
- responsible for the ship’s administration (bunkering, crew-lists, customs clearance, detailed operational documentation, daily reports and statistics).
- shiphandling in harbour and during SAR-operations. Together with the officers you will familiarise the crew on the bridge and introduce them to the watch system.
- You will provide the crew with trainings and drills in emergency situations (e.g. what to do in case of fire, POB, ingress of water, unwanted visitors).
- You will work closely with the Head of operations during SAR operations, double checking all decisions against crew and ship safety as well as stability (and guest safety in case of guest already on board).
- You will work closely with the officers and chief engineer

Required:

-EC/EEA-Citizen Passport valid for at least 6 months

-Covid certificate with EU QR code needed, latest vaccine or recovery certificate no older than 180 days or a booster (other nationalities can be transferred to EU certificate)

-Seafarer Medical Certificate (fitness for sea service) according STCW I/9 (Deck Service)

-Proficiency in basic safety (STCW VI/1)

-Proficiency in survival craft and rescue boats other than fast rescue boats (STCW VI/2-1)

-Proficiency in Advanced fire fighting (STCW VI/3)

-Medical First Aid (STCW VI/4-1)

-Medical Care (STCW VI/4-2)

-GMDSS Radio Operator GOC (STCW IV/2)

-COC Master 500GT-3000GT or more than 3000GT (STCW II/2)

-German Endorsement for COC Master Course

-Seafarer's book or the German Seafarer's ID Card

-Excellent and fluent English language skills

-Confidence in decision-making, strong team leading skills, and the ability to cooperate well within a team of volunteers with various levels of nautical experience and skill.

Desired:

- Previous SAR experience
- Italian, French and Arabic language skills

Cabonline Latvia ir starptautisks pakalpojumu centrs, kas kopš 2005. gada Latvijā nodrošina operacionālo atbalstu Cabonline grupas uzņēmumiem Ziemeļvalstīs. title: Kiemsargis
description:
1.    Palaikyti švarą ir tvarką mokyklos teritorijoje.
2.    Kasdien nušluoti takelius, šaligatvius, iškaupti žolę takeliuose ir žaidimų aikštelėse, surinkti šiukšles (1–2 val. prieš ateinant vaikams).
3.    Vasaros, rudens ir pavasario laikotarpiu prižiūrėti bei laistyti gėlynus, pjauti žolę.
4.    Prižiūrėti ir tinkamai eksploatuoti naudojamą techniką: žoliapjovę, žoliapjovės traktorių, trimerius (valyti, tikrinti techninę būklę, atlikti smulkų remontą, laiku informuoti apie gedimus).
5.    Užtikrinti tinkamą technikos saugojimą, laikymą ir priežiūrą ne darbo metu.
6.    Vykdyti kuro sunaudojimo apskaitą, racionaliai naudoti kurą ir kitas eksploatacines medžiagas.
7.    Žiemą nukasti sniegą nuo takelių, šaligatvių, žaidimų aikštelių, įėjimų į pastatą, barstyti takelius smėliu.
8.    Kasdien apžiūrėti inventorių; esant gedimams – remontuoti savo jėgomis arba informuoti pavaduotoją ūkio reikalams.

Uždarbis – bazinė dalis ir komisiniai nuo sandorio maržos.

Pirkimo pusė.

kraunama.

Atskaitymų už priemaišas derinimas su tiekėju iki pakrovimo.
Pardavimo pusė
Pirkėjų paieška ir derybos Lietuvoje, Baltijos šalyse ir eksporto rinkose.
Partijos komplektavimas iš kelių tiekėjų iki vieno kokybės lygio.
Kainos derinimas pagal tarptautinius indeksus.
Pasiūlymų teikimas su aiškiu galiojimo terminu.
Sandorio vedimas
Eksporto ir atliekų vežimo dokumentai: Annex VII per DIWASS, GPAIS lydraščiai, sąskaitos,
svėrimo pažymos, CMR, eksporto deklaracijos.
Konteinerių užsakymas ir pakrovimo koordinavimas su aikštele bei ekspedicija.
Svorio ir kokybės pretenzijų po iškrovimo sprendimas.
Apmokėjimo sekimas iki pinigų gavimo.
Regionas
Pasiteisinus pirmiems rezultatams – naujo regiono atidarymas ir jo tiekėjų tinklo formavimas.
