title: PhD Candidate in Human-Centred Design for AI Companionship and Care in Ageing Societies
employer: NTNU FAKULTET FOR ARKITEKTUR OG DESIGN
description:
This is NTNU

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 9,000 employees and 43,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.

   

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_KHQjc4ndas&t=41sAbout the position

The Department of Design at NTNU invites applications for a fully funded PhD position within the Human-Centred Artificial Intelligence (HCAI) Lab at NTNU Gjøvik. The position offers an opportunity to conduct mixed method research, applying human-centred design methods and Human-Computer Interaction (HCI) perspectives to investigate how AI companionship technologies may reshape experiences of care, companionship, emotional support, wellbeing, and autonomy among older adults.

Your immediate leader will be the Head of Department.


About the project

Many countries are experiencing demographic changes associated with ageing populations, increasing pressure on healthcare systems and growing concerns regarding social isolation and loneliness among older adults. A large body of research shows that this, in turn, can pose severe risks to their physical and mental health, eroding community social resilience and impacting quality of life – as well as longevity in general. 

At the same time, advances in AI have led to the development of conversational agents, AI companions, and socially assistive technologies designed to provide social and emotional support while removing barriers like accessibility and stigma. Within this context, the PhD candidate will contribute to developing conceptual and functional prototypes that explore alternative futures for AI companionship and care using action-oriented, empathy-driven, and inclusive design methods. 


Duties of the position
  • Complete the doctoral education until obtaining a doctorate
  • Research on why and how AI companionship can address challenges of ageing population
  • Engage in developing, testing, and evaluating prototypes in-house as well as with external stakeholders
  • Take part in both scientific and popular science dissemination
  • Participate in the HCAI Lab and relevant research networks
  • Be involved in international activities, such as conferences and/or research stays at foreign educational institutions
  • Teaching
  • Other career-promoting work 

Be prepared for changes to your work duties after employment.


Required selection criteria
  • You must have a master's degree in design or a related field
  • You must have a strong interest in human-centred AI and the societal implications of AI technologies
  • You must have experience with building prototypes
  • You must have experience with qualitative methods and/or mixed methods
  • Your course of study must correspond to a five-year Norwegian course, where 120 credits have been obtained at the master's level. Master students can apply, but the master's degree must be obtained and documented before starting the position and no later than 15th of July 2027.
  • You must have an average grade from your master's degree studies, or equivalent education, which is equal to a B or better compared to NTNU's grading scale. If you do not have letter grades from previous studies, you must have an equally good academic foundation. If you have a weaker grade background, you may be considered if you can document that you are particularly suitable for a PhD education.
  • You must meet the requirements for admission to the faculty's Doctoral Programme
  • You must have good oral and written presentation skills in Norwegian or another Scandinavian language equivalent to level B2, as well as excellent written and oral communication skills in English

The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position.


Preferred selection criteria
  • Experience conducting user-oriented studies, such as interviews, workshops, or co-design activities
  • Knowledge of accessibility, universal and inclusive design, ageing, wellbeing, healthcare technologies, or welfare technologies
  • Dissemination of research in relevant venues

Personal characteristics

We seek a PhD candidate who is:

  • Curious, open-minded, and motivated to explore innovative HCAI solutions
  • Able to work independently and collaboratively
  • Interested in combining theory, research, and design practice
  • Enthusiastic about connecting with people and engaging with real-world societal challenges
  • Willing to contribute to a positive work atmosphere

Emphasis will be placed on personal qualities.


We offer
  • An exciting job with an important mission in society
  • Developing tasks in a strong and international professional environment
  • Career guidance and follow-up during the PhD period
  • Open and inclusive working environment with committed colleagues
  • Working capital that can be used to implement the project
  • Mentor programme as a new employee at NTNU
  • Favorable terms as a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK)
  • Free Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)

As a PhD Candidate at NTNU, you will have access to employee benefits.


Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals. 

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

At NTNU we want to increase the proportion of women in scientific positions. We have a number of measures to promote equality.


Salary and conditions

In the position of PhD Candidate, code 1017, your gross salary will normally be NOK 580 000,-per annum depending on qualifications and seniority. A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary. 

The employment period is 4 years for the doctoral work 12 months of career promotion work.

For employment as a PhD Candidate, it is a prerequisite that you gain admission to the PhD programme in [subject area] (link to possible website)within three months of your employment contract start date, and that you participate in an organized doctoral programme through out the period of employment.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important that you keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and adapt to them.

For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, are considered to bein conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to be employed.


About the application

The attachments (including a description of your scientific work) must accompany the application as these documents form the basis of the application assessment. The documents must be in Norwegian/a Scandinavian language or English. (decide on this - remove if not applicable)

Please note: the application will only be assessed on the basis of the information we have received by the application deadline. Therefore, make sure that your application clearly shows how your skills and experience meet the criteria described above. The application and all attachments must be sent electronically via Jobbnorge.no. If you are invited to an interview, you must bring certified copies of certificates and diplomas upon request.

The application must include:

  • Cover letter describing motivation for the position
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV)
  • Copies of academic transcripts and diplomas
  • Master's thesis (or equivalent major research project)
  • Publications and other scholarly work (if applicable)
  • Portfolio demonstrating design, prototyping, or research work (if applicable)
  • Research Vision Statement (maximum two pages, excluding references)
  • Names and contact information of three relevant referees


If all, or parts, of your education has been taken abroad, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education, both Bachelor's and Master's education, in addition to other higher education. If your institution uses “diploma supplement” (normal for most European institutions), you must attach this. A description of the documentation required can also be found here. If you already have a statement from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir), please attach this as well.


Joint work will be considered. If it is difficult to identify your contribution to joint work, you must attach a brief description of your participation.

When assessing the best qualified, we emphasize necessary qualifications such as education, experience and personal suitability. Motivation for the position, ambitions, and potential for research will also count when assessing the candidates.

NTNU recognizes a wide range of academic contributions and has committed itself to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment and CoARA (responsible assessment of research and recognition of a greater breadth of academic contributions in accordance with NTNU's social mission).


General information

A public list of applicants with name, age, job title and municipality of residence is prepared after the application deadline. If you wish to be exempt from entry on the public applicant list, this must be justified. Assessment will be made in accordance with current legislation. You will be notified if the exemption is not granted.

If you think this position looks interesting and in line with your qualifications, you are welcome to apply.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Associate Professor Anne Britt Torkildsby, +47 90193130, anne.torkildsby@ntnu.no, Associate Professor Yavuz Inal, +47 41301855,  yavuz.inal@ntnu.no or Postdoctoral Fellow Sujay Shalawadi, sujay.shalawadi@ntnu.no.

Application deadline: 26.10.2026

-----------------

For practical information about working at NTNU, please visit this webpage. 

Gjøvik, a charming town by the shores of Lake Mjøsa, is known for its beautiful nature and rich cultural offerings. The town boasts a vibrant community with excellent schools, modern healthcare services, and a variety of recreational activities. With its strategic location, just a short drive from Oslo, Gjøvik combines the best of urban life and natural experiences. Here, you'll find a dynamic business environment and exciting career opportunities in a setting that values work-life balance. 

 


Om arbeidsgiveren:

NTNU - knowledge for a better world

The Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU) creates knowledge for a better world and solutions that can change everyday life.

Department of Design

We are located in both Trondheim (industrial design) and Gjøvik (graphic design and web technology). Both groups have expertise in interaction design and share research interests in health and welfare technology. The design environment links many technology communities at NTNU, and nationally the Department has extensive collaboration with Norwegian industrial companies. The Department of Design is one of four departments in the Faculty of Architecture and Design.

title: Tenure-track position in Archaeology
description:
About the position 

A tenure-track position (tenure-track in a postdoctoral position and tenured as associate professor) in Archaeology is available at The Department of Archaeology, Conservation and History (IAKH), University of Oslo. IAKH comprises the three disciplinary fields of archaeology conservation and history. The archaeology section has nine academic faculty positions, each with teaching and research components. The section’s research profile and teaching program are internationally oriented and span archaeologies of the Stone Age to the present. The announced position is focused on GIS, statistics and Mesolithic archaeology in Scandinavia.

The announced tenure-track position starts as a full-time postdoctoral position (SKO 1352) for a period of six years, including a 25 % component devoted to teaching and administrative duties. These duties include obtaining basic pedagogical qualifications. A formal midterm evaluation will be held in the fourth year of this period, and the candidate will receive feedback on performance relative to the requirements for the six-year tenure-track period. Toward the end of the six-year period, the candidate will be evaluated for a tenured position as associate professor (SKO 1011). During the final assessment, the candidate’s research performance will first be assessed by an expert (adjudication) committee within the candidate’s subject area. Subsequently, the candidate will be interviewed by an internal interview committee assessing the full range of criteria in the contract of employment.


More about the position 

Applicants apply with a research project including GIS, statistics and the Mesolithic in Scandinavia to be carried out in the initial six years period. In the application letter, candidates should also describe long term plans for building an international research group, for future development of the teaching in Stone Age Archaeology, for contributing to the public dissemination of research, and for developing their own academic career. 

The contract of employment will specify results, requirements, and criteria regarding academic production, public dissemination, research leadership and teaching that the candidate must fulfil during the six-years period to be favourably evaluated for a tenured position. According to the Regulations on appointments to tenure-track positions, with supplementary provisions for UiO, the contract of employment will also specify the criteria for the midterm and final assessment of competencies and milestones. Candidates will also be evaluated on personal suitability and ability to contribute to academic citizenship, both during the initial hiring process and during the mid-term and final evaluations. The contract of employment will further outline the Department’s obligations in supporting the candidate’s research as well as offering academic mentorship, guidance and training. 

Make sure to follow the description of required results necessary in order to be eligible for the tenured position as associate professor.


Requirements 
  • PhD or equivalent academic qualifications within archaeology of the Mesolithic in Scandinavia, with a clear profile in GIS and statistical analysis, granted within the past five years (excluding documented parental and sickness leaves) 
  • Thorough knowledge of the material culture of the Mesolithic in Scandinavia 
  • Demonstrated ability to handle large datasets, geographical information systems and theoretical perspectives on archaeological methodology/practice 
  • Experience in handling of archaeological data using high-end digital tools for quantitative and/or qualitative analysis 
  • Experience with interdisciplinary research approaches within the environmental humanities and/or crossing over to natural sciences 
  • Documented pedagogical skills (either a teaching course certificate or based on teaching experience), see how to document your pedagogical skills 
  • Documented potential for project acquisition • Interest and ability in leadership and administration 
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English and a Scandinavian language 
  • Personal suitability and motivation for the position 

To be eligible, candidates must have submitted for final evaluation or defended their doctoral dissertation within five years preceding the application deadline. In the former case, the appointment will be contingent upon the successful defence of the thesis. Someone who has been employed for more than one year in an ordinary postdoctoral position at the University of Oslo cannot be employed in a postdoctoral position on tenure-track terms.


In the evaluation of the applications, emphasis will be placed on:
  • The research project’s scientific merit and contribution to GIS-based and statistical approaches to the Mesolithic in Scandinavia, including the applicant’s academic and personal ability to carry out the project 
  • The applicant’s long-term plans for building and leading an international research group and successfully join in academic collaboration within and across disciplines, including plans for obtaining external research funding 
  • Academic qualifications and academic production. Originality and quality of publications will be weighted more heavily than quantity 
  • Interest in and motivation for teaching, ability to inspire and provide guidance to students, and potential to teach university-level courses about Stone Age Archaeology and within Archaeology more generally 
  • Interest and ability in leadership and administration, including collaborative skillsExperience with and potential for popular dissemination and public outreach 
  • Academic citizenship, personal suitability and potential to contribute to a positive working environment and the long-term development of teaching and research at the Department 

In the evaluation of the qualified candidates the full range of these criteria will be explicitly addressed and assessed. Academic quality, development, potential and breadth will be prioritised in this order. 

The appointed candidate should demonstrate mastery of both English and one of the Scandinavian languages as working languages.


We can offer you 
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development.
  • Committed colleagues in a good working environment. 
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities. 
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes.
  • Salary in position as Postdoctoral Fellow, position code 1352 in salary range NOK from 595 000 to 677 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund.

Read more about the benefits of working in the public sector at Employer Portal.


We need different perspectives in our work 

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues—could you be the next one?

We will provide appropriate accommodations should you need them. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps, we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports.

More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.

We hope you will apply for the position with us. 


Application

Your application must include: 

  • Application letter describing the applicant’s qualifications and motivation for the position 
  • Curriculum Vitae (including list of education, previous and current positions, teaching experience, administrative experience, and other qualifying activities) 
  • List of publications 
  • Project description (3 - 5 pages, maximum 14,000 characters. See Template for project descriptions) 
  • A realistic progress plan for all six years, including activities beyond the postdoctoral research project itself, such as teaching, professional development and project development 
  • Two writing samples (e.g. two chapters from the PhD dissertation or two academic articles) 
  • Copies of educational certificates 

Please note that all documents should be in English (or a Scandinavian language), either in the original or in translation. 

The application with attachments must be delivered in our electronic recruiting system, jobbnorge.no. Applicants with education from non-Norwegian universities must attach an explanation of their grading systems.


Selection procedure

As the first step in the evaluation process, a Selection Committee will assess all applications and invite the most qualified applicants to submit a teaching portfolio and academic works (up to 7 publications) for expert assessment. Academic texts, except for the two writing samples, shall therefore not be enclosed with the initial application. Applicants who are invited to submit academic works are asked to select three works, published within the last 5 years, to be considered as most relevant for the position. In longer publications (monographs), applicants should specify the most relevant pages. Applicants are also asked to submit a teaching portfolio of 3-6 pages documenting educational certificates, competence and experience, including a reflection note in which your own practice and learning vision is anchored in the principles of Scholarship of Teaching and Learning (SoTL). 

Finally, the most highly ranked candidates will be invited for at least one interview and trial lecture. Ranked candidates will be asked to provide a list of 3 reference persons (name, relation to candidate, e-mail and phone number). References are contacted after the interviews.


General information

Please note that we are unable to add documentation after the application deadline. As the deadline applies equally to all applicants, this policy ensures equal treatment throughout the recruitment process. If you experience difficulties uploading documents in Jobbnorge, please contact their customer service: Phone: +47 75 54 22 20 or Email: support@grade.com 

The primary method of communication throughout the process will be e-mails and messages through the recruitment system Jobbnorge. When you receive a notification of a message in Jobbnorge, please log in to read it, as it may be important.

The best qualified candidates will invited for interviews. 

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we cannot, you will hear from us.

Please refer to Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian) and Guidelines concerning appointment to recruitment positions at UiO. 

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees to secure the rights to all research results and related intellectual property.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest ranked educational and research institution, with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. With its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally recognised research communities, UiO is an important contributor to society.

The Department of archaeology, conservation and history (IAKH) is comprised of three disciplines which in different ways study the past.The department has internationally oriented archaeologists, the only conservation program in Norway and the biggest group of historians in Scandinavia. The department has close to 100 employees, including non-permanent research fellows. The study programs span archaeology from the Stone Age to the Middle Ages, object and paintings conservation, and history from Antiquity to the present age.

title: Product Manager
description:
About Six Robotics

At Six Robotics, we build intelligent software that gives Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) the ability to collaborate, adapt on the fly, and execute missions that were previously impossible.

From our base in Oslo, our team of 90+ engineers, researchers, and defence specialists develops our autonomy and swarm platform, used by both government and industry. Working closely with the Norwegian Defence Research Establishment (FFI) and end users, we move quickly from ideas to field deployment, solving problems where software meets the real world.

The challenges we work on don’t come with existing playbooks. They demand deep technical thinking, close collaboration across disciplines, and the ability to learn quickly as both the technology and the company evolve.

At Six Robotics, every person executes with precision, adapts to changing conditions, and strengthens the team. If you’re excited about building systems that matter and growing alongside talented people that push boundaries every day, you’ll find no better place to deliver real-world impact.


About The Role

At Six Robotics, our product department is built around a clear flow: needs emerge from our customers, are shaped into product features, and are then translated into engineering-ready functionality. As we scale, we are strengthening our Product Team to own this flow end-to-end. This role will build and own the bridge between these domains, ensuring that what we ship is not driven by ad-hoc requests, but by validated needs from the field, strong technical context, and disciplined product decisions.

As a Product Manager at Six Robotics, you will turn complex project needs, field feedback, and long-term strategy into a coherent, executable product direction. This is a hands-on, operational product role at the center of engineering, projects, and real-world UAV operations.

You will help define where our software product, Valkyrie, is going. Defining what gets built, and why, without abstracting away the reality and context the engineering teams need to succeed and understand.

This role is critical in bringing stability, clarity, and long-term focus to how Valkyrie evolves, while still adapting to real-world demands from customers, field operations, and live deployments.

You will work closely with the other Product Managers and report to the Chief of Product, bringing clarity to our Engineering Team Leads, release and project management, acting as the bridge that ensures we build the right capabilities, at the right time, for the right reasons.


What You Will Do

  • Translate project and customer requirements into actionable product features: prioritize, scope, and refine features so engineering can execute with clarity and confidence.

  • Shape the product roadmap alongside the Head of Product: contribute to the vision, break it down into a detailed plan, and ensure it drives meaningful, deliverable work.

  • Bring clarity to engineering to ensure we build the right features: minimize product debt, reduce ad-hoc feature work, and safeguard long-term product quality.

  • Own operational product execution: track progress, manage priorities, and follow up on releases to keep product development structured and predictable.

  • Maintain product clarity and coherence: oversee trade-offs, dependencies, and release content to ensure each feature delivers real value internally before reaching engineering.

  • Validate and refine assumptions in the field: work and test the features with our field teams, to understand real-world performance and feed insights back into product decisions.


What we are looking for

We are looking for someone with exceptional structure and decision-making skills. We believe this person can confidently say no when needed, set direction, and still listen deeply to both the team and the customer. You thrive in ambiguity, bringing discipline and method where things feel uncertain, and you take ownership not just of your own work, but across teams and interfaces. You are comfortable challenging customers constructively, asking why they want something, and translating that into what is actually feasible and valuable for engineering to build. At the same time, you are hands-on, willing to dive into the details when necessary, without ever losing sight of priorities or long-term outcomes.


We believe the right candidate brings

  • Proven experience working on the development of mission-critical software products, with clear ownership from idea to delivery.

  • Strong understanding of the full product lifecycle - from requirements and specification to delivery, validation, and iteration.

  • Strong background in building software products, with the ability to collaborate with engineers while keeping problems concrete and solvable.

  • Experience in structuring and governing product flow - balancing prioritization, planning, dependencies, and release coordination.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex customer needs into clear engineering context, without losing the bigger picture.

  • A competitive drive and delivery mindset. You care about outcomes, not just process.

  • Fluency in English (Norwegian not required).

Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience with UAVs, autonomy systems, robotics, or defence-related technology.

  • Exposure to hardware-software integrated products or field-deployed systems.


Why you should join

  • Build at the edge of what’s possible: You’ll work on problems the industry hasn’t solved yet, alongside people who are pushing the boundaries of autonomy, AI, and robotics.

  • Grow as fast as the company: We believe that chance favours those in motion. The role you’re hired into is just the starting point. As Six Robotics evolves, so will your scope, your responsibilities, and your opportunities.

  • Work with exceptional people: Surround yourself with people who raise your own standards. You’ll join a team of ambitious engineers and operators who care deeply about the quality of their work. Expectations are high, but so is the willingness to help each other improve.

  • Ship work that matters. The things you build don't stay in a demo environment. They get deployed, tested, and used where reliability and performance genuinely matter.

  • Supported by great benefits. Alongside meaningful work, we offer competitive compensation, equity potential, strong pension and insurance plans, gadget budgets, modern equipment, panoramic offices, and the flexibility you need to do your best work.


Our Recruitment Process

We want hiring to be transparent and respectful of your time. We aim to move with momentum while making thoughtful hiring decisions - because every new team member matters.

Our process typically includes:

  • Initial phone screening (30 min): A conversation about your background, motivation, and the role.

  • First interview (45 min): Meet the hiring team, learn more about Six Robotics, and discuss your experience.

  • Second interview (60–90 min): A technical discussion/Case interview, typically including a take-home assignment with a case presentation.

  • Final interview (45 min): Meet members of our leadership team to align expectations and answer any remaining questions.

Reference checks are conducted before an offer is finalized. We review applications continuously, so don't leave us hanging. Send us your application today!


Our Commitment to Inclusion

At Six Robotics, we are committed to creating a workplace built on respect, integrity, and collaboration. We value different perspectives and experiences, and we believe that diversity within our team strengthens both our work and our culture. We encourage all qualified candidates to apply and help us build technology that makes a real impact.


Security Clearance Requirement

All employees at Six Robotics must be eligible for security clearance. Some roles might require a high level of clearance, depending on the nature of the work. If you are hired, we’ll guide you through any required authorization or clearance process as part of your onboarding. Previous authorization or clearance is not required, but all candidates must be eligible to obtain the necessary approvals if required for their role.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

We exist to strengthen defence, protect nations, and deter conflict in an era defined by unmanned warfare. Our mission is to multiply operational capabilities, accelerate the transition to robotic warfare, and give NATO and our allies a decisive advantage in the new era of unmanned operations. We overcome the limits of current systems with collaborative swarm autonomy, enabling unmanned systems to act as one. Our software lets drones collaborate, adapt, and execute missions as a team, allowing a single operator to control an army of robots, accelerate decisions, and multiply combat effectiveness.

title: Industrial Designer
description:
Nofence is a Norwegian scale-up that has built the world’s first virtual fencing solution for livestock. As we aim to revolutionize livestock management, we will need top-notch competence in our Engineering team, and we are now looking for an Industrial Designer.


Your main responsibilities will be:

  • Generate and visualize design concepts and mechanical solutions for our future livestock hardware products, taking them from early ideas to production-ready models.

  • Design for manufacturing by cooperation with mechanical and manufacturing engineers.

  • Develop the design guidelines for industrial design in the company.

  • Contribute to field research on farms and ranches to observe livestock interactions, working conditions, and operator workflows to inform design concepts.

  • Design products that prioritize animal welfare, prevent injury, and ensure ergonomic, intuitive handling for farmers and agricultural technicians.

  • Partner with Product Management and UX design to translate user feedback, field research, and competitive insights into compelling, feasible physical product concepts.


We are looking for someone who has:

  • Bachelor or Master degree in industrial or product design.

  • Experience designing electro-mechanical products for volume manufacturing.

  • Excellent visualization skills on paper and with physical and digital models.

  • Creative problem-solving skills for complex design solutions.


We are looking for someone who is:

  • Motivated by working in an autonomous cross-functional team.

  • Structured with the ability to bridge the gap between user needs and design for manufacturing.

  • Motivated to facilitate workshops and creative sessions.

  • Comfortable working in an English-speaking work environment.

  • Drivers license and ability to travel abroad.


About Nofence

Managing livestock has always been a challenge. Humanity has tried everything from herding with dogs to walling the animals in with barbed wire, electric, and wooden fences, but these are costly and time-consuming solutions and often in conflict with the local wildlife. It has also left vast areas of potential pasture overgrown and underutilized.


Until now.

Enter virtual fences. What started as a small group of farmers and engineers with a big idea has become Nofence – the world’s first virtual fencing solution for livestock.


What we bring to the table

At Nofence, we're not your typical 9-to-5 gig. We're a dynamic scale-up, creating a work atmosphere that's anything but ordinary. It's a place where dedication and innovation are the norm, offering great opportunities for your personal and professional growth.

We believe in seeing results fast. As an engineer with us, your work won't be lost in the bureaucratic shuffle. You'll witness the immediate impact of your contributions in real-time, influencing the evolution of our cutting-edge virtual fencing solution for livestock.

Join us, where ambition meets reality, and let's keep pushing the boundaries in the world of agri-tech!

Please submit your application directly through this portal. In line with applicable data protection regulations and our data protection practices, we are unable to accept or process applications received by email. Applying through the portal also ensures your personal data is handled securely. We review applications on a rolling basis and look forward to hearing from you!

If you have any questions about Nofence or regarding the application, please reach out to our Engineering Manager Kjetil Grimsæth at below email.

title: Har du lyst til å dra på skattejakt etter ressurser i folk?
description:
Hos Driv Karriere tror vi at alle mennesker har ressurser som kan utvikles og benyttes i arbeid eller utdanning. Nå søker vi en engasjert jobbveileder til et 12 måneders vikariat i tiltaket Arbeidsforberedende trening (AFT), med mulighet for fast ansettelse. AFT er ikke et anbudsutsatt tiltak.

Hva vi ser etter

Kvalifikasjoner

  • Minimum 3-årig utdanning fra høyskole eller universitet.

  • Relevant videreutdanning er en fordel.

  • Kompetanse innen veiledningsmetodikk er ønskelig.

  • Førerkort klasse B og disponering av egen bil.

  • Personlig egnethet vil bli vektlagt.

Hvem er du?

Du er en person som ser muligheter der andre ser hindringer. Du bygger lett gode relasjoner, skaper tillit og bistår mennesker til å ta nye steg mot arbeid eller utdanning.

Du liker å samarbeide med både deltakere, arbeidsgivere og andre samarbeidspartnere, og du trives i en rolle hvor ingen dager er helt like. Du er løsningsorientert, kommuniserer godt og motiveres av å finne gode løsninger sammen.

Du har kjennskap til arbeidslivet, utdanningsmuligheter og relevante støtteordninger, og ser hvordan ulike muligheter kan åpne dører for mennesker som trenger litt ekstra bistand på veien.

Det er en fordel om du har erfaring med arbeidsinkludering, karriereveiledning, tilrettelegging eller oppfølging av personer med ulike utfordringer. Har du også kunnskap om kartlegging av arbeidsevne og veiledningsmetodikk, er det et pluss.

Som person er du selvstendig, samtidig som du trives med å være en del av et team. Du er nysgjerrig, har evne til selvutvikling og refleksjon og er komfortabel med digitale verktøy.

Å bygge nettverk og samarbeide med næringslivet for å skape muligheter for arbeid og inkludering, er noe du kan like. Kanskje trives du også med å dele kunnskap og lede grupper?

Kort sagt: Du brenner for å gjøre en forskjell og ønsker å bidra til at flere mennesker finner veien til arbeid, utdanning og mestring.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Som jobbveileder er din viktigste oppgave å styrke deltakernes muligheter og sammen finne gode løsninger for å komme i arbeid eller utdanning. Du vil ha en egen portefølje med deltakere som av ulike årsaker trenger tett, individuell veiledning og oppfølging for å nå sine mål.

Du vil blant annet:

  • Kartlegge deltakernes ressurser, muligheter og mål.

  • Veilede mot arbeid, utdanning og kompetanseheving.

  • Etablere og utvikle samarbeid med arbeidsgivere og andre aktører.

  • Formidle deltakere til utdanning eller ordinært arbeid.

  • Følge opp deltakere og arbeidsgivere gjennom hele prosessen, også etter ansettelse.

  • Følge opp deltakere som starter i utdanning.

  • Bidra til tilrettelegging som fremmer mestring og inkludering.

  • Samarbeide tett med Nav og øvrige samarbeidspartnere.

  • Dokumentere utvikling og utføre skriftlige faglige vurderinger.

Har du lyst til å gjøre en forskjell?

Vi tilbyr

Hos oss får du:

  • En variert arbeidsdag hvor du jobber både med mennesker og næringsliv.

  • God faglig støtte og oppfølging fra teamleder og kolleger, samt opplæring i metoder og verktøy.

  • Godt arbeidsmiljø med fokus på å finne gode løsninger og spille hverandre gode.

  • Muligheter for både faglig og personlig utvikling.

  • Fleksibel arbeidstid.

  • Gode forsikring- og pensjonsordninger.

  • Mulighet for trening i arbeidstiden.

  • Lønn etter avtale.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Driv Karriere er en arbeids- og inkluderingsbedrift med base i Mo i Rana. Vi tror at alle mennesker har ressurser som kan utvikles og benyttes i arbeid, utdanning og aktiv deltakelse i samfunnet. Gjennom arbeidsrettede tiltak, kurs og opplæring bidrar vi til at flere opplever mestring, utvikling og nye muligheter.

Hos oss står mennesket i sentrum. Vi møter mennesker med respekt, varme og tro på deres muligheter, og skaper trygge arenaer der aktivitet, fellesskap og læring gir grunnlag for varig endring. Arbeid og deltakelse er viktig for både helse, livskvalitet og tilhørighet, og vi jobber hver dag for å bidra til et mer inkluderende arbeidsliv.

Vi leverer tjenester i Rana, Hemnes, Nesna, Lurøy og Hattfjelldal, og samarbeider tett med NAV, arbeidsgivere og andre aktører. Våre tjenester bygger på høy faglig kompetanse, kvalitet og et sterkt engasjement for menneskelig utvikling. Sammen bidrar vi til økt inkludering, sterkere fellesskap og et samfunn der flere får mulighet til å delta.

description:
Har du erfaring med yrkes- eller karriereveiledning og motiveres av å hjelpe mennesker videre mot arbeid? Vi søker en selvstendig veileder til vårt Oppfølgingstiltak i Kirkenes.

Dette er en deltidsstilling på inntil 60 %. Vi har ikke anledning til å tilby full stilling, og ser derfor særlig etter deg som ønsker en varig deltidsrolle, eventuelt i kombinasjon med annet arbeid.

Om rollen

Som veileder følger du opp personer som trenger individuelt tilpasset støtte for å komme i, eller beholde, arbeid. Du skal sammen med den enkelte kartlegge kompetanse, muligheter og mål, og omsette dette til konkrete aktiviteter som bringer deltakeren nærmere arbeidslivet.

En sentral del av jobben er yrkes- og karriereveiledning. Du må kunne hjelpe deltakere med å se realistiske jobbmuligheter, forstå hva arbeidsgivere etterspør og finne alternative veier når den opprinnelige planen ikke fører frem.

Stillingen innebærer også tett kontakt med lokalt arbeidsliv. Du tar initiativ til arbeidsgiverkontakt, bygger nettverk og arbeider aktivt for å finne aktuelle praksis-, utprøvings- og jobbmuligheter.

Du vil arbeide selvstendig lokalt i Kirkenes, samtidig som du får faglig støtte fra tiltaksleder i Finnmark og kolleger i JobLoop.

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Individuell arbeidsrettet oppfølging av deltakere

  • Yrkes- og karriereveiledning

  • Kartlegging av kompetanse, interesser, arbeidsevne og jobbmuligheter

  • Utarbeidelse og oppfølging av individuelle planer

  • Veiledning i CV, søknad, intervju og jobbsøkerstrategi

  • Aktiv kontakt med arbeidsgivere og lokalt næringsliv

  • Etablering og oppfølging av praksis- og arbeidsplasser

  • Samarbeid med NAV og andre relevante aktører

  • Dokumentasjon av aktiviteter, progresjon og resultater

Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi ønsker først og fremst å komme i kontakt med deg som har praktisk erfaring med yrkesveiledning, karriereveiledning eller arbeidsrettet oppfølging.

Du kan for eksempel ha erfaring fra NAV, arbeidsinkludering, karrieresenter, attførings-/tiltaksvirksomhet, rekruttering eller andre tjenester hvor målet har vært å hjelpe mennesker inn i arbeid.

Det er særlig relevant om du har erfaring med flere av følgende områder:

  • Yrkes- eller karriereveiledning

  • Arbeidsrettet oppfølging

  • Formidling av kandidater til arbeid

  • Kontakt og samarbeid med arbeidsgivere

  • Tilrettelegging og arbeidsinkludering

  • Oppfølging av personer som står utenfor arbeidslivet

  • Dokumentasjon og bruk av digitale arbeidsverktøy

Relevant høyere utdanning er en fordel, men erfaring og dokumentert kompetanse kan være like viktig.

Førerkort klasse B er en fordel.

Kjennskap til samisk språk, kultur og lokale forhold i Øst-Finnmark er positivt, men ikke et krav.

Vi tror du vil passe godt i rollen dersom du

  • er trygg i veilederrollen og kan utfordre på en konstruktiv måte

  • klarer å se realistiske jobbmuligheter sammen med den enkelte

  • tar initiativ og oppsøker arbeidsgivere fremfor å vente på at muligheter skal dukke opp

  • arbeider strukturert og selvstendig

  • bygger tillit hos både deltakere, arbeidsgivere og samarbeidspartnere

  • trives med ansvar og en arbeidshverdag som ikke alltid er forutsigbar

Personlig egnethet vil bli tillagt stor vekt.

Vi tilbyr

  • En meningsfull deltidsstilling på inntil 60 %

  • Stor grad av selvstendighet i arbeidshverdagen

  • Mulighet for å kombinere stillingen med annet arbeid

  • Et fagmiljø med kompetanse innen arbeidsinkludering, pedagogikk, IT og rekruttering

  • En rolle der du får tett kontakt med både mennesker og lokalt arbeidsliv

  • Mulighet til å bidra konkret til økt arbeidsdeltakelse i Øst-Finnmark

Viktig før du søker: Stillingen passer best for deg som faktisk ønsker å arbeide deltid og som har erfaring med yrkes-/karriereveiledning eller tilsvarende arbeidsrettet oppfølging. Vi oppfordrer deg til å beskrive denne erfaringen konkret i søknaden.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

JobLoop skaper muligheter for fler! Vi vant prisen Årets Sosiale Entreprenør 2024 for vårt arbeid med å forebygge frafall fra skolen og inkludere flere til arbeid og utdanning.

Sammen med JobLoop arbeider du med mennesker som av ulike grunner opplever barrierer på veien inn i arbeidslivet. Vi samarbeider tett med lokale skoler, arbeidsgivere, NAV og andre kommunale kontor for å tilby gode kvalifiseringsløp og bærekraftige rekrutteringsmodeller. Behovet er i dag spesielt synlig innen utvikler-bransjen og på arbeidsplasser med økte krav til digital kompetanse.

Sammen med gode nettverk arbeider JobLoop aktivt for å utvikle og tilby innovative metoder som fremmer inkludering i arbeidslivet og forebygge frafall i skolen. Tilgang på en jobb er for mange nøkkelen til et godt og stabilt liv, og utdanning er som regel første steg.

Selskapet inviterer til varierende og spennende arbeidsmuligheter og drives av sosiale entreprenører, faglige veiledere, utviklere, spillpedagoger og jobbspesialister

Hva vi ser etter
  • Ansvarsbevisst og pålitelig.

  • Praktisk anlagt og løsningsorientert.

  • Strukturert og nøyaktig i arbeidet.

  • En god lagspiller som bidrar til et positivt arbeidsmiljø.

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Utføre arbeid i henhold til tegninger, krav og gjeldende standarder.

  • Samarbeide tett med arbeidsleder, maskinførere og øvrig mannskap.

  • Sikre kvalitet, nøyaktighet og korrekt innmåling i utførelsen av arbeidet.

  • Følge HMS-rutiner og bidra til en trygg og sikker arbeidsplass.

Kvalifikasjoner

Vi ser etter deg som har:

  • Fagbrev som anleggsrørlegger eller ADK1-sertifikat.

  • God forståelse for tekniske tegninger og VA-normer.

  • Erfaring med grøftearbeid og kumarbeid.

  • Fokus på kvalitet, sikkerhet og HMS.

  • Førerkort klasse B.

  • Gode norskkunnskaper, både muntlig og skriftlig.

  • Høy yrkesstolthet og et ønske om å levere kvalitet i alle ledd.

Vi tilbyr

  • Fast ansettelse i 100 % stilling med snarlig oppstart.

  • Konkurransedyktige lønns- og arbeidsvilkår, inkludert tariffavtale og AFP-ordning.

  • Varierte og spennende VA-prosjekter med mulighet til å bidra på viktige infrastrukturprosjekter.

  • Gode muligheter for faglig utvikling gjennom kurs, sertifiseringer og videreutdanning.

  • Gode personalordninger og et sterkt sosialt fellesskap.

  • Et trygt og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø med fokus på samarbeid, HMS og faglig stolthet.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

I 2025 tok vi steget videre: Vuku Naturstein ble tilAarstad Anlegg. Med nytt navn og ny profil - men med de samme folka, den samme kompetansen og den samme kvaliteten i bunn.

Vi leverer anleggstjenester innen vei, vann og avløp, fjernvarme og anleggsgartnerarbeid, og har oppdrag for kommune, fylke og stat. Det er både krevende og meningsfullt - og det liker vi.

Vi er et team på rundt 25 medarbeidere - fra lærlinger til grunnarbeidere, anleggsrørleggere, maskinførere, lastebilsjåfører, ingeniører og spesialsykepleier. Vi kommer med ulik bakgrunn, men har én ting til felles: vi brenner for faget.

Hos oss får du kollegaer med høy kompetanse, lang erfaring og stort hjerte for jobben. Vi jobber målrettet for å sikre et sterkt fagmiljø og et trygt, inkluderende arbeidsmiljø der folk trives og får utvikle seg.

description:
Hos Aarstad Anlegg er vi stolte av folkene våre. Nå søker vi anleggsmaskinfører som ønsker å bidra med kompetanse, pågangsmot og godt samarbeid ute på prosjektene våre.

Hva vi ser etter

Vi ser etter deg som trives bak spakene og har stolthet i det du leverer. Du jobber strukturert og sikkert, og tar ansvar både for eget arbeid og for laget rundt deg. Du kommuniserer tydelig og godt med kollegaer ute på prosjekt, og bidrar til et godt samarbeid i hverdagen.

Du trives med å jobbe selvstendig når det kreves, samtidig som du er en positiv bidragsyter i team. Hos oss er det viktig at du har fokus på kvalitet og HMS, og at du ønsker å bidra til å få jobben gjort skikkelig - hver dag.

  • Sørge for drift, vedlikehold og daglig kontroll av anleggsmaskiner.

  • Bidra til god HMS og dokumentasjon av utført arbeid.

  • Erfaring som arbeidsleder (BAS/formann) er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

Kvalifikasjoner

  • Fagbrev i anleggsmaskinførerfaget.

  • Høy yrkesstolthet og fokus på kvalitet i arbeidet.

  • Gode norskkunnskaper, både muntlig og skriftlig.

  • Førerkort klasse B.

  • Reisearbeid må påregnes.

Vi tilbyr

  • Fast ansettelse i 100 % stilling med snarlig oppstart.

  • Konkurransedyktige lønns- og arbeidsvilkår, inkludert tariffavtale og AFP-ordning.

  • Varierte og spennende VA-prosjekter med mulighet til å bidra på viktige infrastrukturprosjekter.

  • Gode muligheter for faglig utvikling gjennom kurs, sertifiseringer og videreutdanning.

  • Gode personalordninger og et sterkt sosialt fellesskap.

  • Et trygt og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø med fokus på samarbeid, HMS og faglig stolthet.

  • Muligheten til å jobbe i en fremtidsrettet entreprenørbedrift med høy aktivitet og spennende prosjekter i regionen.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

I 2025 tok vi steget videre: Vuku Naturstein ble til Aarstad Anlegg. Med nytt navn og ny profil - men med de samme folka, den samme kompetansen og den samme kvaliteten i bunn.

Vi leverer anleggstjenester innen vei, vann og avløp, fjernvarme og anleggsgartnerarbeid, og har oppdrag for kommune, fylke og stat. Det er både krevende og meningsfullt - og det liker vi.

Vi er et team på rundt 25 medarbeidere - fra lærlinger til grunnarbeidere, anleggsrørleggere, maskinførere, lastebilsjåfører, ingeniører og spesialsykepleier. Vi kommer med ulik bakgrunn, men har én ting til felles: vi brenner for faget.

Hos oss får du kollegaer med høy kompetanse, lang erfaring og stort hjerte for jobben. Vi jobber målrettet for å sikre et sterkt fagmiljø og et trygt, inkluderende arbeidsmiljø der folk trives og får utvikle seg.

title: Har du lyst til å dra på skattejakt etter ressurser i folk?
description:
Hos Driv Karriere tror vi at alle mennesker har ressurser som kan utvikles og benyttes i arbeid eller utdanning. Nå søker vi en engasjert jobbveileder til et 12 måneders vikariat i tiltaket Arbeidsforberedende trening (AFT), med mulighet for fast ansettelse. AFT er ikke et anbudsutsatt tiltak.

Hva vi ser etter

Kvalifikasjoner

  • Minimum 3-årig utdanning fra høyskole eller universitet.

  • Relevant videreutdanning er en fordel.

  • Kompetanse innen veiledningsmetodikk er ønskelig.

  • Førerkort klasse B og disponering av egen bil.

  • Personlig egnethet vil bli vektlagt.

Hvem er du?

Du er en person som ser muligheter der andre ser hindringer. Du bygger lett gode relasjoner, skaper tillit og bistår mennesker til å ta nye steg mot arbeid eller utdanning.

Du liker å samarbeide med både deltakere, arbeidsgivere og andre samarbeidspartnere, og du trives i en rolle hvor ingen dager er helt like. Du er løsningsorientert, kommuniserer godt og motiveres av å finne gode løsninger sammen.

Du har kjennskap til arbeidslivet, utdanningsmuligheter og relevante støtteordninger, og ser hvordan ulike muligheter kan åpne dører for mennesker som trenger litt ekstra bistand på veien.

Det er en fordel om du har erfaring med arbeidsinkludering, karriereveiledning, tilrettelegging eller oppfølging av personer med ulike utfordringer. Har du også kunnskap om kartlegging av arbeidsevne og veiledningsmetodikk, er det et pluss.

Som person er du selvstendig, samtidig som du trives med å være en del av et team. Du er nysgjerrig, har evne til selvutvikling og refleksjon og er komfortabel med digitale verktøy.

Å bygge nettverk og samarbeide med næringslivet for å skape muligheter for arbeid og inkludering, er noe du kan like. Kanskje trives du også med å dele kunnskap og lede grupper?

Kort sagt: Du brenner for å gjøre en forskjell og ønsker å bidra til at flere mennesker finner veien til arbeid, utdanning og mestring.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Som jobbveileder er din viktigste oppgave å styrke deltakernes muligheter og sammen finne gode løsninger for å komme i arbeid eller utdanning. Du vil ha en egen portefølje med deltakere som av ulike årsaker trenger tett, individuell veiledning og oppfølging for å nå sine mål.

Du vil blant annet:

  • Kartlegge deltakernes ressurser, muligheter og mål.

  • Veilede mot arbeid, utdanning og kompetanseheving.

  • Etablere og utvikle samarbeid med arbeidsgivere og andre aktører.

  • Formidle deltakere til utdanning eller ordinært arbeid.

  • Følge opp deltakere og arbeidsgivere gjennom hele prosessen, også etter ansettelse.

  • Følge opp deltakere som starter i utdanning.

  • Bidra til tilrettelegging som fremmer mestring og inkludering.

  • Samarbeide tett med Nav og øvrige samarbeidspartnere.

  • Dokumentere utvikling og utføre skriftlige faglige vurderinger.

Har du lyst til å gjøre en forskjell?

Vi tilbyr

Hos oss får du:

  • En variert arbeidsdag hvor du jobber både med mennesker og næringsliv.

  • God faglig støtte og oppfølging fra teamleder og kolleger, samt opplæring i metoder og verktøy.

  • Godt arbeidsmiljø med fokus på å finne gode løsninger og spille hverandre gode.

  • Muligheter for både faglig og personlig utvikling.

  • Fleksibel arbeidstid.

  • Gode forsikring- og pensjonsordninger.

  • Mulighet for trening i arbeidstiden.

  • Lønn etter avtale.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Driv Karriere er en arbeids- og inkluderingsbedrift med base i Mo i Rana. Vi tror at alle mennesker har ressurser som kan utvikles og benyttes i arbeid, utdanning og aktiv deltakelse i samfunnet. Gjennom arbeidsrettede tiltak, kurs og opplæring bidrar vi til at flere opplever mestring, utvikling og nye muligheter.

Hos oss står mennesket i sentrum. Vi møter mennesker med respekt, varme og tro på deres muligheter, og skaper trygge arenaer der aktivitet, fellesskap og læring gir grunnlag for varig endring. Arbeid og deltakelse er viktig for både helse, livskvalitet og tilhørighet, og vi jobber hver dag for å bidra til et mer inkluderende arbeidsliv.

Vi leverer tjenester i Rana, Hemnes, Nesna, Lurøy og Hattfjelldal, og samarbeider tett med NAV, arbeidsgivere og andre aktører. Våre tjenester bygger på høy faglig kompetanse, kvalitet og et sterkt engasjement for menneskelig utvikling. Sammen bidrar vi til økt inkludering, sterkere fellesskap og et samfunn der flere får mulighet til å delta.

description:
Lund’s Tivoli AS is looking for energetic, positive and service-minded people to join our team at the Christmas Market in the heart of Oslo.

  • Able to work efficiently as part of a team

Previous catering or hospitality experience is an advantage, but a positive attitude and willingness to work as part of a team are equally important.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Your main responsibilities will include:

  • Preparing food and operating our food and beverage outlets at the Christmas Market.

  • Restocking products and keeping the workplace clean and organised before, during and after opening hours.

  • Providing friendly and positive service to our guests.

Vi tilbyr

The company covers the cost of accommodation in a good-quality aparthotel located approximately 15--20 minutes walk from the Christmas Market.

Each apartment accommodates four employees and consists of:

  • 2 bedrooms

  • 2 single beds in each bedroom

  • Kitchen/living area

  • 1 bathroom

Laundry facilities are located on each floor of the aparthotel

Travel

The company covers round-trip flights to Oslo , from your capital city and includes one checked piece of luggage.

Salary

Fixed salary: NOK 20,000 gross per month.

Holiday pay (feriepenger) is paid in accordance with Norwegian law and is calculated at 10.2% of the applicable holiday pay basis earned during 2026. Any overtime that is due under Norwegian law will be paid in accordance with the applicable rules.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Lund's Tivoli is part of Lund Gruppen, one of Scandinavia's largest companies within the entertainment industry.

Lund Gruppen operates Oslo's Christmas Market, where we welcome more than 3 million visitors during the Christmas season.

You will be joining an international team and helping create a memorable Christmas experience for visitors from Norway and around the world.

We look very much forward to hearing from you!

title: BPA-assistent søkes til aktiv gutt på 9 år - 100% fast,/avlastning/nattevakt
description:
Jeg er en gutt på 9 år som ser etter noen fine folk som kan bli en del av hverdagen min. Kanskje er du en som liker å være aktiv, kreativ og leken, men som samtidig klarer å være den rolige og trygge voksne når jeg trenger det?

Akkurat nå søker vi først og fremst en assistent i 100 % stilling til og med februar, med mulighet for forlengelse. Det er også aktuelt med mindre faste stillinger og tilkallingsvikarer, så du må gjerne søke selv om fulltid ikke passer for deg.

Først litt om meg:

Jeg er en smilende og pratsom fyr, og det er sjelden stille når jeg først kommer i gang! Jeg liker å tulle, være kreativ og ha noen rundt meg som byr litt på seg selv. De gangene ting blir litt vanskelig, trenger jeg en voksen som klarer å beholde roen selv om jeg ikke gjør det. En som kan hjelpe meg med å skjerme litt, gi meg tid og støtte meg tilbake til en god følelse igjen. Av og til kan jeg teste grenser eller være lite gira på å samarbeide, og da trenger jeg først og fremst at du er trygg, tydelig og tålmodig.

Jeg har Tourettes og ADHD, og det betyr blant annet at det noen ganger kan bli litt mye for både hodet og kroppen min. Hvis det skjer mye rundt meg, planer plutselig endrer seg eller ting ikke blir helt som jeg hadde sett for meg, kan jeg bli urolig eller frustrert. Jeg liker å tegne, male og lage ting, gjerne inspirert av karakterer fra spill og film. Roblox og Minecraft står også ganske høyt på lista, så hvis du synes det er gøy å spille litt sammen med meg, får du fort noen plusspoeng. Jeg liker også å være ute, selv om jeg ikke alltid kommer på ideen helt av meg selv. Med et lite dytt blir jeg gjerne med på tur i skogen eller fjæra, spesielt hvis vi kan lete etter kule steiner til samlingen min. Jeg liker også sykling, trampoline og basketball, så her er det gode muligheter for å være både kreativ og aktiv sammen.

Jeg bor sammen med familien min i et rolig og røykfritt hjem. Her håper jeg å finne en assistent som kan bli en trygg og positiv del av hverdagen min, en som både kan være med på alt det morsomme, og som står stødig ved siden av meg de dagene jeg trenger litt ekstra støtte.

Arbeidstid og sted:

  • Dag, ettermiddag, kveld, natt og helg
  • Det er også mulighet for utvidet arbeidstidsordning og langvakter. Det kan blant annet være aktuelt å jobbe avlastningshelger/langhelger, for eksempel fra fredag til søndag.
  • For deg som liker å jobbe mer sammenhengende og få lengre friperioder mellom arbeidsperiodene, kan dette være en veldig fin måte å organisere arbeidstiden på. Samt kombinere med studier og annen jobb (56 timers vakter)
  • Det vil være mulig å jobbe med studier i dødtid
  • Du kan godt holde til andre steder enn Silsand. Feks. Tromsø/Sørreisa/Bardufoss.

Jeg håper at du er:

  • Rolig, trygg og tålmodig
  • Klarer å være tydelig og trygg
  • Tåler at ting ikke alltid går helt etter planen
  • Gir meg tid til å roe meg ned og omstille meg
  • Kan sette gode og forutsigbare grenser
  • Liker å være aktiv og med på aktiviteter
  • Kan motivere meg når jeg trenger et lite dytt

Har du erfaring med barn, ADHD, Tourettes eller reguleringsvansker er det fint, men personlig egnethet og kjemien mellom oss er viktigst.

Du vil blant annet:

  • Være sammen med meg etter skole, i helger og ellers etter behov
  • Selta i lek, spilling og kreative aktiviteter
  • Motivere meg til å komme meg ut og være i aktivitet
  • Støtte meg når jeg blir overstimulert
  • Hjelpe meg med å finne ro og ta gode pauser
  • Skape struktur og forutsigbarhet rundt dagen
  • Hjelpe meg med gode rammer rundt spilling og skjermtid
  • Støtte meg ved måltider, hygiene og andre daglige rutiner
  • Det vil også være noen praktiske oppgaver knyttet til hverdagen min, som å lage enkle måltider, rydde etter aktiviteter og gjøre lett renhold.

Høres dette ut som noe for deg?

Vi søker deg som har lyst til å bli kjent med meg og være en stabil del av hverdagen min over tid.

Det viktigste er ikke om du kan alt fra før. Det viktigste er at du er villig til å lære, at du møter meg med ro og respekt, og at du klarer å være trygg også de dagene jeg trenger litt mer av deg.

Kanskje er du akkurat den trygge voksne jeg trenger på laget mitt?

Om arbeidsgiveren:

BPA er en forkortelse for brukerstyrt personlig assistanse. Det er i hovedsak en alternativ måte å organisere praktisk bistand på for funksjonshemmede. BPA skiller seg fra mer tradisjonelle tjenester ved at det er personen med assistansebehov som selv bestemmer hvordan assistansen skal være. BPA er et frigjørings- og likestillingsverktøy som bidrar til at den med assistansebehov får frihet til å leve et selvstendig og aktivt liv - på lik linje med andre i samfunnet. Prima Assistanse har spesialisert seg på BPA, og er i dag en betydelig leverandør i hele Norge. Vi jobber hver dag for å bidra til at funksjonshemmede får den friheten og assistansen som er nødvendig for å kunne leve et selvstendig liv. Vi er opptatt av å levere et godt konsept, kvalitet i alle ledd, å ha profesjonelle medarbeidere og gode rutiner, slik at vi sammen bidrar til en suksessfull hverdag. Nysgjerring på hvordan det er å jobbe hos oss? Les mer på vår karriereside: https://prima-assistanse.no/karriere/jobbe-som-bpa-assistent/

title: Postdoctoral Research Fellow in Stochastic Analysis and Computational Methods
description:
About the position

A position as Postdoctoral Research Fellow in Stochastic Analysis and Computational Methods is available at Department of Mathematics, within the section of Risk and Stochastics.

Starting date no later than January 31st, 2027.

The appointment is a full-time position and is for a period of three years (10% of which is devoted to other career-promoting work, usually in the form of teaching activities). 

Depending upon the qualification of the applicant and the current needs of the department, a fourth year may be considered. In this case, a workload of 25% is devoted to career promoting work, usually in the form of teaching and/or supervision duties. In this case, Postdoctoral fellows who are appointed for a period of four years are expected to acquire basic pedagogical competency in the course of their fellowship period within the duty component of 25%.

No one can be appointed for more than one Postdoctoral Research Fellowship at the University of Oslo.

The position is bounded to the SURE-AI consortium agreement and its research scopes. The Centre for Sustainable, Risk-Averse, and Ethical AI or SURE-AI is a Norwegian AI centre funded by the Research Council of Norway (2025-2030). The primary objective is to create a new generation of algorithms for inference and decision-making by pushing the boundaries of the underlying computational techniques. SURE-AI researchers will drive a transformative leap in AI through a groundbreaking Centre initiative dedicated to making Artificial Intelligence more efficient, transparent and safe, addressing the critical challenges of resource consumption, behaviour unpredictability and ethical alignment with human and societal values. The centre involves senior researchers from well-renowned national and international research institutions, in close collaboration with industry and public sector. Overall, SURE-AI includes 19 national Norwegian partners, as well as researchers from 15 international institutions.

Six national research centres for Artificial Intelligence (AI) were launched in the Fall of 2025. These centres will foster interdisciplinary collaboration among researchers to address both scientific and societal challenges, develop new technologies, understand the impact of AI, and drive innovation across both the business and public sectors. This initiative is established and financed through the government's significant investment in artificial intelligence over the next five years

The present postdoctoral position is hosted at the Department of Mathematics, at Blindern campus in Oslo, which is the place of work.


Project description

The position is framed in the strongly interdisciplinary research group of Risk and Stochastics and the Community of SURE-AI. The focus is on the development of original mathematical methods for AI and its applications aimed at the modelling and analysis of complex phenomena particularly within economics and finance, energy finance, sustainable and ethical economics and insurance. 

We are interested in research projects that are deeply grounded in stochastic analysis and show also development of computational methods towards machine learning. The projects will focus on applications to risk-sensitive decision making and control, with the potential to address ethical and human alignment in machine learning research.

For this, candidates with a strong background in the areas of stochastic analysis, Malliavin calculus, forward and backward stochastic differential equations, signature methods, filtering, machine learning and computational stochastics are particularly welcome and are prioritized. Clear interest in computational methods towards applications is appreciated.

We are interested in candidates that can merge into an internationally oriented group with high ambitions in research excellency. It is expected that the fellow takes active part in both the research development and the group’s activities. 

The main purpose of a postdoctoral fellowship is to provide the candidates with enhanced skills to pursue a scientific top position within or beyond academia. To promote a strategic career path, all postdoctoral research fellows are required to submit a professional development plan no later than one month after commencement of the postdoctoral period.


What skills are important in this role?

The Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences has a strategic ambition to be among Europe’s leading communities for research, education and innovation. Candidates for these fellowships will be selected in accordance with this, and expected to be in the upper segment of their class with respect to academic credentials.

Required qualifications:

  • Applicants must hold a degree equivalent to a Norwegian doctoral degree in stochastic analysis, probability or mathematical statistics, numerical methods for stochastics, forward and/or backward stochastic differential equations, stochastic control, stochastic filtering. Doctoral dissertation must be submitted for evaluation by the closing date. Only applicants with an approved doctoral thesis and public defence are eligible for appointment.
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English.

Desired qualifications:

  • Interdisciplinary research experience and/or attitude in the relevant areas is an advantage. 
  • Knowledge of computational methods for stochastics and programming skills.
  • Knowledge in one or more of the following areas: Malliavin calculus, stochastic filtering, risk measures, signature methods.
  • Knowledge of a Scandinavian language may be an advantage for teaching and supervision (if applicable)

UiO is subject to the Security Act, which governs the organisation's protection of security-sensitive objects and knowledge, in addition to other relevant legislation concerning access to and handling of sensitive information. Based on this, it is a requirement that successful applicants are security-eligible. We may use background checks as part of our recruitment process.


What are we looking for in you?

Personal skills:

The fellow is expected to take part in the activities of the Section of Risk and Stochastics. We are expecting a person able to work in structured manner both independently and as part of a team, swiftly adapting to new tasks. In general, a positive attitude and the ability to handle hectic periods is an advantage. A genuine interest in taking part in the various aspects of the academic life with collaborative and pro-active attitude is highly appreciated. 
Good communication skills are important.

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal skills.


We can offer you
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development
  • Committed colleagues in a good working environment
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.  
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities
  • Postdoctoral development programmes.
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes
  • Salary in position as Postdoctoral Fellow, position code 1352 in salary range NOK 595 000 - 690 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund

We need different perspectives in our work

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues, could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps (Norwegian), we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports. More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here. 

We hope you will apply for the position with us.


How to apply

The application must include:

  • Cover letter (statement of motivation, summarizing scientific work and research interest)
  • Project description (no more than 3 pages, excluding references)
  • CV (summarizing education, positions, pedagogical experience, administrative experience and other qualifying activity)
  • Copies of educational certificates, academic transcript of records
  • A complete list of publications and up to 5 academic works that the applicant wishes to be considered by the evaluation committee
  • Names and contact details of 2-3 references (name, relation to candidate, e-mail and telephone number)

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job".

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


General information

The best qualified candidates will be invited for interviews.

Please see the guidelines and regulations for appointments to Postdoctoral fellowships at the University of Oslo.

If an applicant has applied for and been granted funding for a fulltime research stay abroad while being employed as a Postdoctoral Research Fellow, the employment will be prolonged with the equivalent time as the research stay, but for no longer than of twelve months ( thus extending the employment to a maximum of four years)

No one can be appointed twice as a Postdoctoral fellow financed with funds from The Research Council of Norway (NFR).

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we can't, you will hear from us.

The University of Oslo has an agreement for all employees, aiming to secure rights to research results a.o.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest rated institution of research and education with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. Its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally esteemed research communities make UiO an important contributor to society. 

The Department of Mathematics is part of the Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences at the University of Oslo. The Department is engaged in teaching and research covering a wide spectrum of subjects within mathematics, mechanics and statistics. The research is on theory, methods and applications. The areas represented include: fluid mechanics, biomechanics, statistics and data science, computational mathematics, combinatorics, partial differential equations, stochastics and risk, algebra, geometry, topology, operator algebras, complex analysis and logic.

We have almost 50 persons in permanent academic positions and a large number of post docs and Ph.D. students. We also have an administrative and technical staff. The department represents a leading research environment in mathematical areas in Norway, and has a highly international profile.
