description:
💪 Assisterende senterleder i SATS

Har du et ønske om å jobbe med mennesker, samtidig som du vil bidra til å bekjempe en av vår tids største helseutfordringer? Det er nettopp det vi gjør i SATS ved å inspirere medlemmene våre og gjøre dem sunnere og gladere. Som assisterende senterleder støtter du senterleder i den daglige driften av senteret, med særlig fokus på salg, medlemsservice og renhold. Du bidrar til at senteret fremstår innbydende, er godt vedlikeholdt og gir medlemmene en best mulig opplevelse.

Du er «manager on duty» og har det overordnede ansvaret på sentret når senterleder ikke er til stede. Trives du i en aktiv og variert rolle der ingen dager er like, kan dette være stillingen for deg!


🏋️ En viktig lederrolle i en kompleks drift

SATS-sentrene våre er aktive møteplasser med høy aktivitet gjennom store deler av dagen. Som assisterende senterleder har du en sentral rolle i å sikre at den daglige driften fungerer sømløst for både medlemmer og medarbeidere. Stillingen innebærer ansvar for mennesker, drift, medlemsopplevelse og resultater, og du må trives med å håndtere flere oppgaver samtidig. Du er en tydelig leder i hverdagen, tar beslutninger når det er nødvendig, og bidrar til at senteret holder høy standard innen service, salg, renhold og sikkerhet. Dette er en operativ lederrolle for deg som ønsker å ta ansvar, trives i et høyt tempo og evner å skape struktur og gode opplevelser i en variert og til tider hektisk arbeidshverdag.

🌟 Dine ansvarsområder:

  • Salg og medlemsvekst: Aktivt samarbeide med ditt team for å ønske nye medlemmer velkomne og levere eksepsjonell kundeservice til en hver tid.

  • Yte eksepsjonell service: Være tilstede og imøtekommen både i resepsjonen og i treningsområdet for å sørge for at våre medlemmer blir ivaretatt.

  • Sørge for et rent og trygt senter: Passe på at alle områder er ryddige, godt vedlikeholdte og oppfyller SATS sine høye standarder.

  • Bistå med administrative oppgaver: Støtte med administrative oppgaver, organisering og planlegging for å sikre fremdrift.

  • Fleksibilitet: Arbeidstiden din vil variere fra tidlig morgen til sent på kveld, samt i helger for å sikre tilstedeværelse i de mest travle tidspunkter.


🤩 Kjenner du deg igjen? 

  • Du har gode kommunikasjonsevner, og har en sosial tilnærming til andre mennesker.

  • Du er strukturert og ryddig, samt ansvarsfull og pliktoppfyllende.

  • Du liker salg, kundeservice og renhold.

  • Snakker flytende norsk og engelsk.

  • Etterlever våre verdier: Members First, Accountable, Professional, and Extraordinary.


🚀 Hvorfor jobbe i SATS:

  • Mulighet til å gjøre en forskjell: Hjelpe mennesker med å bli sunnere og lykkeligere.

  • Bli en del av et mestringsteam: Du vil jobbe med likesinnede mennesker som deler de samme verdiene og lidenskap.

  • Utvikling: Gode utviklingsmuligheter blant annet gjennom vårt interne utdanningstilbud - SATS Academy.

  • Flere appellerende personalgoder.


🤝 Samarbeid:

Du vil jobbe tett med senterleder, og få hjelp fra våre støttefunksjoner, inkludert HR og regionale ledere.

Er du klar for en spennende og givende rolle med store utviklingsmuligheter og ønsker å gjøre en forskjell? Da vil vi gjerne høre fra deg!


Ønsket oppstart i denne stillingen er snarest, eller etter nærmere avtale.


#SATSNorge
#LI-AB1

Om arbeidsgiveren:

SATS Group, through our brands and concepts SATS, ELIXIA and Fresh Fitness, is the leading provider of fitness and training services in the Nordics with over 275 clubs, some 10 000 employees and around 700,000 members. At SATS, everyone is welcome and our members have full flexibility to tailor packages for their individual needs. We offer cutting-edge studio facilities for individual training, the broadest offering of group training programs, and highly qualified personal trainers for specialized training and individual coaching. We also focus strongly on supporting our members with online training and digital tools when they are unable to visit our club facilities. We are constantly working with trend research and innovation to be the industry’s best and most forward-looking fitness chain.

title: Sykepleier/ Miljøterapeut Botiltak
description:
100% Fast stilling på Botiltak

Tjenester til hjemmeboende i Hol kommune søker en engasjert medarbeider til fast stilling ved Botiltak.

 

Om stillingen

  • 100% fast stilling fordelt på 2 Botiltak
  • Ønsket tiltredelse:Snarest
  • Arbeidssted er Stensheim i Hol og Botiltak på Geilo

Avdelingen tilbyr tjenester til personer med nedsatt funksjonsevne og behov for langvarige og sammensatte kommunale tjenester. Vi yter helsehjelp og praktisk bistand til brukere i eget hjem, med vekt på mestring, trygghet og verdighet.

Som ansatt vil du være en viktig del av det daglige arbeidet og bidra til å sikre individuelt tilpassede, trygge og gode tjenester. Vi legger til rette for at den enkelte bruker skal kunne leve et mest mulig selvstendig liv i eget hjem, samtidig som vi støtter deltakelse i aktiviteter og et aktivt og meningsfylt sosialt fellesskap.

Stillingen innebærer turnusarbeid med 12,5-timers vakter (dag, kveld og helg), og tett samarbeid med fagpersonell og øvrige kolleger.

Arbeidssted er Stensheim i Hol og bolig på Geilo

 

Arbeidsoppgaver

· Gi helsehjelp og praktisk bistand til brukere

· Observere, vurdere og rapportere endringer i helsetilstand

· Håndtere legemidler etter gjeldende rutiner og kompetanse

· Dokumentere i elektronisk pasientjournal

· Bidra til et godt samarbeid med brukere, pårørende og kolleger

· Delta i utviklings- og kvalitetsarbeid

 

Kvalifikasjoner

· Sykepleier eller annen relevant høyskole utdanning

· Gode norskkunnskaper, muntlig og skriftlig

· Førerkort klasse B

· Grunnleggende digitale ferdigheter

 

Personlige egenskaper

· Selvstendig og ansvarsbevisst

· Gode samarbeidsevner

· Fleksibel og løsningsorientert

· God observasjonsevne

· Omsorgsfull og respektfull i møte med brukere

 

Vi tilbyr

· Et godt og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø

· Varierte og meningsfulle arbeidsoppgaver

· Muligheter for faglig utvikling

· Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger

· Lønn og tillegg i henhold til tariffavtale. Beholde og rekkruteringstillegg på 20000,- til 40000,- 

. Nedbetaling av studielån med 25000,- pr år etter gjeldene regler

 

 

Ved tilsetting må du kunne legge frem politiattest uten anmerkning.

Har du spørsmål eller ønsker mer informasjon, kontakt arbeidsleder Anja Keil Michelsen på tlf 95 70 17 35

 

Søknader vil bli vurdert fortløpende.

 

Velkommen som søker!


Link til søknadsskjema: Søk her

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Hol kommune er nasjonalparkkommune med ca 4.500 innbyggere, og Geilo er nasjonalparklandsby. Kommunen er en av landets største turistkommuner der Geilo er største tettsted, og ble nylig kåret til det beste skistedet i Norge. Hol kommune ligger i Norges største reiselivsregion, Hallingdal, med Hardangervidda rett ved. Bergensbanen og sentralt veinett gjør kommunen godt tilgjengelig. Vi har et rikt og aktivt kulturliv med mange lag og foreninger som ønsker deg velkommen. Flott og variert natur med utallige tilbud sommer som vinter. Kommunen har full barnehagedekning og gode barneskoler/ ungdomsskole, samt toppidrettsgymnas. Mulighet for desentralisert høyskoletilbud.

title: PhD Candidate in International Business
description:
This is NTNU

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 9,000 employees and 43,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.

   

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_KHQjc4ndas&t=41sAbout the position

The position is at NTNU in Ålesund at the School of International Business. We are looking for candidates with an educational background in international business or international management. However, other business and management degrees, including technology management, innovation management, organizational leadership and behavior, or human resource management, will also be considered.

Are you motivated to take a step towards a doctorate and open up exciting career opportunities? As a PhD Candidate with us, you will work to achieve your doctorate and, at the same time, gain valuable experience that qualifies you for a future career in higher education and research, both within and beyond academia.

Your immediate leader will be the Head of Department.


About the project

Digital technologies such as artificial intelligence, automation, and remote operations are transforming not only where people work, but also how work is organized. As technologies redistribute tasks, expertise, decision-making authority, and responsibility across people and locations, they can reconfigure established roles, relationships, and ways of working. These changes raise important leadership questions: How do leaders help employees navigate changing roles and responsibilities? How are trust, shared understanding, and coordination maintained when work becomes increasingly technology-mediated and geographically distributed? And how do leadership practices emerge as established authority structures are reshaped by technology?

These leadership challenges can become particularly pronounced in culturally diverse teams, where members may differ in their expectations regarding leadership, authority, autonomy, participation, communication, and responsibility. Such differences may reflect both the cultural composition of the team and the cultural values and orientations of individual members. The aim of this PhD project is to investigate how leadership and culture jointly shape responses to technology-driven changes in distributed work, with particular attention to how leaders navigate culturally diverse expectations as new ways of working emerge, and how these processes influence trust, role clarity, and coordination. 

The PhD project seeks to advance research on leadership, cross-cultural management, and technology-driven organizational change, potentially using remote maritime operations as a relevant empirical context in which geographically dispersed and culturally diverse actors must navigate shifting roles and authority while coordinating effectively in a safety-critical environment.

The successful candidate will have scope to develop the theoretical framework, research questions, and methodological design within the project's overall direction.


About the proposal

The PhD candidate should develop and submit a proposal within the scope of the topic, and, if selected as the preferred candidate, conduct research on the topic. Preferably, the PhD candidate’s research should focus on industries relevant to the Møre and Romsdal county, such as the marine and maritime industries.


Duties of the position
  • Complete the doctoral education until obtaining a doctorate
  • Carry out research of good quality within the framework described above
  • Academic publications and popular science dissemination
  • Participate in the research group on international business and innovation.
  • Participate in international activities such as conferences and/or research stays at foreign educational institutions

Be prepared for changes to your work duties after employment.


Required selection criteria
  • You must have an academically relevant background, preferably within international business or international management. However, other business and management degrees including technology management, management of innovation, organizational leadership and behavior, or human resource management may also apply. 
  • You must have a master’s degree in international business, international management, business administration, or equivalent. Your course of study must correspond to a five-year Norwegian course in which 120 credits have been obtained at the master's level. Master's students can apply, but the master's degree must be obtained and documented before starting the position. 
  • You must have a strong academic background from your previous studies and have an average grade from your Master's degree studies, or equivalent education, which is equal to B or better compared to NTNU's grading scale. If you do not have letter grades from previous studies, you must have an equally good academic foundation. If you have a weaker academic background, you may still be considered if you can demonstrate that you are particularly well-suited for a PhD program.
  • You must meet the requirements for admission to the faculty of economics and management doctoral programme (https://www.ntnu.edu/ok/research/phd)
  • Good oral and written presentation skills in English and/or Norwegian.

PLEASE NOTE: For detailed information about what the application must contain, see paragraph “About the application”.

 

The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position.


Preferred selection criteria
  • Good knowledge of industries represented in the region, such as the marine, maritime and furniture industry, both local and global.
  • Have strong motivation for advanced research work demonstrated by a motivation letter and a proposal within the scope of the project description above.
  • Good demonstrated theoretical and analytical skills.
  • Contribute to a positive work environment in general is emphasized.

Personal characteristics

To complete a doctoral degree (PhD), it is important that you are able to: 

  • Work independently
  • Work in a structured way, set goals and make plans to achieve them
  • Present and discuss your research with other professionals
  • Get involved and contribute constructively with feedback
  • Work constructively under pressure or in the face of adversity 
  • Show curiosity and a strong motivation for the subject
  • Analyze data, assess different perspectives and draw well-founded conclusions 
  • Be flexible and open to adjusting the plan for the project as needed

Emphasis will be placed on personal qualities.


We offer

 

  • An exciting job with an important mission in society
  • Developing tasks in a strong and international professional environment
  • Career guidance and follow-up during the PhD period
  • Open and inclusive working environment with committed colleagues
  • Working capital that can be used to implement the project
  • Mentor programme as a new employee at NTNU
  • Favorable terms as a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK)
  • Free Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)

As a PhD Candidate at NTNU, you will have access to employee benefits.


Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals. 

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

At NTNU we want to increase the proportion of women in scientific positions. We have a number of measures to promote equality. (delete if not applicable)


Salary and conditions

In the position of PhD Candidate, code 1017, your gross salary will normally be NOK 580 000,-per annum depending on qualifications and seniority. A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary. 

The employment period is 3 years.

For employment as a PhD Candidate, it is a prerequisite that you gain admission to the PhD programme within three months of your employment contract start date, and that you participate in an organized doctoral programme through out the period of employment.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important that you keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and adapt to them.

For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, are considered to bein conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to be employed.


About the application

The attachments (including a description of your scientific work) must accompany the application as these documents form the basis of the application assessment. The documents must be in Norwegian or English. 

Please note: the application will only be assessed on the basis of the information we have received by the application deadline. Therefore, make sure that your application clearly shows how your skills and experience meet the criteria described above. The application and all attachments must be sent electronically via Jobbnorge.no. If you are invited to an interview, you must bring certified copies of certificates and diplomas upon request.

The application must include: 

  • Transcripts and diplomas for Bachelor's and Master's degrees
  • CV 
  • Copy of Master's thesis. If you have recently submitted your Master's thesis, you can attach a draft of the thesis. Documentation of a completed Master's degree must be presented before taking up the position.
  • Project outline containing proposals for an overall description of research questions, theoretical perspectives, methodological design for the project, and progress plan (maximum 2000 words/5 pages) 
  • Short letter of motivation (400 words/1 page)
  • Possibly publications, etc., other relevant research work
  • Possibly certificates
  • Possible letter(s) of reference/recommendation
  • Names and contact information of three relevant referees


If all, or parts, of your education has been taken abroad, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education, both Bachelor's and Master's education, in addition to other higher education. If your institution uses “diploma supplement” (normal for most European institutions), you must attach this. A description of the documentation required can also be found here. If you already have a statement from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir), please attach this as well.


Joint work will be considered. If it is difficult to identify your contribution to joint work, you must attach a brief description of your participation.

When assessing the best qualified, we emphasize necessary qualifications such as education, experience and personal suitability. Motivation for the position, ambitions, and potential for research will also count when assessing the candidates.

NTNU recognizes a wide range of academic contributions and has committed itself to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment and CoARA (responsible assessment of research and recognition of a greater breadth of academic contributions in accordance with NTNU's social mission).


General information

A public list of applicants with name, age, job title and municipality of residence is prepared after the application deadline. If you wish to be exempt from entry on the public applicant list, this must be justified. Assessment will be made in accordance with current legislation. You will be notified if the exemption is not granted.

If you think this position looks interesting and in line with your qualifications, you are welcome to apply.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact the Head of Department, Associate Professor Mark Pasquine (mapa@ntnu.no), Professor Ghulam Mustafa (guma@ntnu.no), or the Deputy leader, Research & Innovation, Professor Richard Glavee-Geo (rigl@ntnu.no). If you have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact HR Adviser Oddny Lyngvær at email: oddny.lyngvar@ntnu.no or telephone: +47 95011957. 

Application deadline: 25.10.2026

-----------------

For practical information about working at NTNU, please visit this webpage. 

 

Ålesund, known for its unique Art Nouveau architecture and spectacular nature, is a gem on Norway's west coast. The city offers a vibrant cultural life, modern facilities, and a dynamic business environment. With its strategic location by the sea, Ålesund provides a perfect balance between urban living and natural experiences. Here, you will find excellent schools, top-notch healthcare services, and a wide range of recreational activities. Ålesund is an ideal place for both career and family life, with a safe and inclusive community.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

NTNU - knowledge for a better world

The Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU) creates knowledge for a better world and solutions that can change everyday life.

NTNU School of International Business

The School of International Business is one of four departments in the Faculty of Economics and Management. Our department is located at the Ålesund Campus with core expertise in international business, marketing, innovation, organization & leadership, and entrepreneurship, which play a key role and are closely linked to the region’s needs. We also conduct research and teaching in other areas of business administration and management and maintain close relationships with local businesses and industry.

title: Vil du være en stemme for personer med utviklingshemning og bidra til et sterkere BPA-tilbud?
description:
Brenner du for at personer med utviklingshemning skal bli sett, hørt og forstått – og få leve et liv preget av trygghet, selvbestemmelse og gode muligheter?

Vi ser etter deg som forstår hvor viktig dette arbeidet er, og som vet at gode rammer, trygge relasjoner og riktig bruk av BPA kan gjøre en stor forskjell – både for den enkelte og for menneskene rundt. Vi ser etter deg som har egenerfaring med BPA og utviklingshemning, eller som har utdanning eller arbeidserfaring fra feltet – og som ønsker å bruke denne erfaringen til å skape noe bedre. For oss handler dette om mer enn tjenester og systemer. Det handler om retten til å bestemme over eget liv, om beslutningsstøtte som skaper trygghet, og om å se personen bak behovet. Du ønsker å bidra til at flere forstår hva BPA faktisk kan bety: frihet, mestring, deltakelse og en hverdag der mennesker får større rom til å være seg selv.


Stillingen kan ha arbeidssted flere steder i landet, fortrinnsvis i Trondheim eller Oslo, og inngår i fagavdelingen vår. Du blir en del av et lite og nært team i et større arbeidsmiljø, med mulighet til å jobbe med noe du brenner for. Hvis du liker utviklingsarbeid, faglige diskusjoner og å bidra til konkrete forbedringer i menneskers hverdag, kan dette være riktig sted for deg. I denne stillingen er det ikke CV-en eller ønsket stillingsprosent som teller mest. Rollen formes etter den rette personen. Det viktigste for oss er hvem du er, hva du har med deg, og hvordan engasjementet og erfaringene dine kan bidra til at personer med utviklingshemning får en enda tryggere, friere og bedre hverdag.


Vi ser for oss at du:

  • Har egenerfaring, utdanning eller arbeidserfaring innen utviklingshemning og BPA
  • Ønsker å dele kunnskap, erfaringer og perspektiver som kan gjøre oss bedre
  • Ønsker å bidra til å utvikle og styrke BPA-tilbudet for personer med utviklingshemning
  • Er engasjert og tydelig, og opptatt av verdighet, rettferdighet og selvbestemmelse
  • Arbeider strukturert og selvstendig, og er trygg på å følge opp egne oppgaver


Dette kan vi tilby:

  • En rolle der stemmen, erfaringen og engasjementet ditt virkelig betyr noe
  • Mulighet til å arbeide for en viktig sak som påvirker hverdagen til mange mennesker og deres pårørende
  • En fleksibel arbeidshverdag som kan tilpasses deg, kompetansen og livssituasjonen din
  • Meningsfylt arbeid i et sterkt, inkluderende og engasjert fellesskap


Dette er en mulighet til å bruke erfaringen din til noe som virkelig betyr noe. Vi håper du vil være med oss på laget! Vi behandler søknader fortløpende, så om dette treffer noe i deg, håper vi du søker.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

I Prima Assistanse ser vi stor verdi av å være en mangfoldig organisasjon. Derfor ønsker vi at du uavhengig av etnisitet, alder, kjønn, legning, funksjonsnedsettelse, utdanning eller bakgrunn søker på jobb hos oss. Gjennom verdiene våre "humor, tillit, fleksibilitet og lagarbeid" jobber vi hver dag for at alle skal få frihet til å leve! BPA er en forkortelse for brukerstyrt personlig assistanse. Prima Assistanse har spesialisert seg på BPA, og er i dag en betydelig leverandør i hele Norge. Vi jobber hver dag for å bidra til at funksjonshemmede får den friheten og assistansen som er nødvendig for å kunne leve et selvstendig liv. title: BPA-assistenter søkes i 50% fast og i tilkallingsstilling

title: Founding Business Development Representative
description:
Who we are looking for

As our Founding Business Development Representative (BDR), you'll be the engine behind our sales pipeline - the first Birdsview person many prospects talk to. You'll open doors across Europe and beyond, working closely with our sales team to turn interest into qualified opportunities.

Birdsview - Prolonging the lifetime of the built world

Birdsview is a Norwegian technology company on a mission to change the way we preserve critical infrastructure to ensure a more sustainable and secure future.

Infrastructure is one of society’s most important assets. It includes the buildings we live in, the bridges we cross and the power grid that provides us with electricity. These structures are aging rapidly, and solutions that help preserve and secure critical infrastructure are now needed more than ever.

Birdsview's state-of-the-art technology combines radar (GPR), lidar, and AI to visualize what’s inside structures without destructive interventions. This allows for efficient and cost-effective inspection and monitoring of our most precious infrastructures - and enables clear, user-friendly visualizations that enhance understanding, extend asset lifespan, and promote material reuse - ultimately reducing costs and CO₂ emissions.

We are 17 people, we have customers in 9 countries, and we raised NOK 40.5 million from leading Nordic VC's to scale internationally.

About the job and why it matters

Much of concrete inspection today still relies on manual methods and fragmented, ageing non-destructive testing (NDT) equipment. You will help structural engineers, contractors, surveying specialists, and asset owners see clearly what is hidden inside the concrete. New critical data, faster inspections, and real cost savings are why they want our technology in their daily projects.

As a Founding BDA, you will be the engine behind our international growth. The role is to reach the right prospects, understand the problems they face, and show them what our technology does. You will build target account lists in HubSpot, make cold calls, drive LinkedIn and email outreach, and book qualified meetings for our sales team. This is a foundational role in a newly established sales team, where you will have a direct impact on our strategy, processes, and success.

  • Build the target list
    Research accounts across Europe and North America, and find the people who actually make the decision.

  • Run outbound
    Personalised outreach by phone, email and LinkedIn - plus follow-up on inbound leads and contacts from conferences.

  • Qualify and book
    Qualify opportunities, book meetings for the sales team, and keep our CRM clean enough that we can see what works.

  • Know the product and the market
    Deeply enough to have real conversations, not scripted ones.

  • Sharpen the message
    Feed back what you hear from prospects so marketing can build on it.

What we're looking for

  • Hunger and dedication to win.

  • Clear writing, thoughtful research, and confidence on the phone.

  • Outbound experience in SaaS, tech or another B2B role is a plus, not a requirement. Able to build pipeline yourself.

  • Organised and self-driven.

  • Comfortable working in a CRM. We use HubSpot.

  • At home where the process is still being figured out, you're helping figuring it out.

  • Fluent in English. Norwegian, German, Spanish or French is a strong plus given where our customers are.

Why this is interesting

  • Top-tier colleagues
    Work alongside leading people in a supportive and ambitious team culture, with regular social events and company trips.

  • Build it yourself
    Be a foundational member, directly shaping our international sales strategy and playbook.

  • Room to grow
    We're building the commercial team right now. What you own in a year depends on what you build in the first six months.

  • Impact
    Make a tangible impact on preserving critical infrastructure and fostering a circular economy.

  • Compensation
    Competitive salary, commission, and equity - become an owner.

  • Location
    Work in Bergen or Oslo with a fast-moving, hands-on team. Excellent working facilities at StartupLab centrally located in both cities.

View the full details for the job here.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Help us take Birdsview global!

Birdsview is building the "MRI for concrete", turning scans into clear answers about what's inside a structure, without breaking it open. Survey companies, structural engineers, and construction companies in 9 countries already use it in the field.

Who we are

Birdsview is building the "MRI for concrete", turning a scan into clear answers about what's inside a structure, without breaking it open. Survey companies, structural engineers, and construction companies in 9 countries already use it in the field.

We just closed a NOK 40.5 million funding round to scale internationally, and we're building our sales organization from the ground up. That's the opportunity here: this isn't a seat on an existing team following an existing playbook — it's a chance to help write it.

We're a team of 17 today, based in Bergen and Oslo, moving fast and covering a lot of ground.

Key figures

  • 9 countries
    Customers

  • 17
    Employees

Our culture

🌍 Impactful work
Contribute to a sustainable future by prolonging the lifetime of the built world and circular economy

🤝 Collaborative team
Work alongside curious, innovative, and inspiring individuals.

🚀 Shared ownership
Take individual responsibility and help build the company's future.

Some benefits we offer

📈 Stock options
Share in our success and become a company owner.

⏰ Flexible work
Enjoy adaptable working hours and locations.

📚 Learning and growth
Access continuous development.

title: Veileder (arbeidsrettet)
description:
Ønsker du en meningsfull jobb der du hver dag kan bidra til at mennesker finner veien til arbeid og mestring?

Nav Gjesdal søker engasjerte veileder til et ettårig vikariat i arbeidsrettet avdeling. Vi ser etter deg som har tro på den enkeltes muligheter, som er opptatt av arbeidsinkludering og som evner å kombinere relasjonskompetanse med struktur og målrettet oppfølging. Hos oss blir du en del av et faglig sterkt miljø som sammen jobber for å skape gode resultater for innbyggerne våre og arbeidsgivere.

Ved Nav Gjesdal får du en variert arbeidshverdag med tett oppfølging av mennesker som har behov for Nav sine tjenester, samtidig som du skal samarbeide med arbeidsgivere og andre aktører for å bidra til at flere når sine mål om arbeid og aktivitet. En del av oppgavene dine vil også innebære å kontakte organisasjoner og bedrifter for å sammen skape muligheter og øke inkludering i arbeidslivet for mennesker som står utenfor arbeidslivet.

Nav Gjesdal kan tilby en spennende og utviklende arbeidsplass med et godt fagmiljø blant våre ca. 20 medarbeidere. Våre kontorlokaler er sentralt plassert på Ålgård, med kort vei til buss. 

Ønsker du å gjøre en forskjell? Da håper vi du søker på stillingene som veileder hos oss! 


Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Helhetlig veiledning og arbeidsrettet oppfølging av personer som av ulike årsaker står utenfor arbeidslivet.
  • Veiledning og forvaltning i tråd med gjeldende lovverk.
  • Initiere og koordinere samarbeid med aktuelle samarbeidspartnere som behandlere, tiltaksarrangører og arbeidsgivere m. flere
  • Utadrettet kontakt med bedrifter og organisasjoner med mål om samarbeid som skaper muligheter for innbyggerne våre.
  • Bidra til økt arbeidsdeltakelse og aktivitet.

Nav er i stadig endring og utvikling, og variasjon og endringer i arbeidsoppgaver over tid vil derfor måtte påregnes.

Kvalifikasjoner

Du må ha: 

  • Fullført utdannelse tilsvarende bachelorgrad, fortrinnsvis innen sosial-, helse- eller samfunnsfag. Solid og relevant erfaring og/eller utdanning kan kompensere for utdanningskravet. 
  • Erfaring med veiledning og oppfølging av mennesker, fortrinnsvis med mål om arbeid eller utdanning.
  • God muntlig og skriftlig kommunikasjons- og fremstillingsevne (norsknivå på B2 eller tilsvarende nivå må kunne dokumenteres for søkere uten norsk som morsmål). 
  • Gode digitale ferdigheter med kjennskap til Microsoft 365. Du må kunne sette deg raskt inn i og håndtere flere ulike fagsystem.  
  • Personlige egenskaper vektlegges i stor grad. DNV GL-sertifisert personlighetstest vil bli brukt i rekrutteringen.

Videre ønsker vi at du også har:  

  • Erfaring med saksbehandling og en god forståelse av det å jobbe etter lovverk.
  • Erfaring med kartlegging av arbeidsevne.
  • Kjennskap til lokalt arbeidsmarked og erfaring fra samarbeid med arbeidsgivere.

Utenlandske utdanningsgrader må være HK-Dir/NOKUT-godkjent. Vitnemål og annen relevant dokumentasjon må lastes opp som vedlegg innen søknadsfristen. 

Personlige egenskaper

For at du skal trives og lykkes i rollen som veileder i Nav Gjesdal, er det særlig viktig at du innehar følgende personlige egenskaper:

  • Relasjonsbygger/nettverksbyggende: Du kommuniserer aktivt med mennesker både i og utenfor organisasjonen. Du oppsøker andre for å utvikle nye relasjoner og ivaretar eksisterende.
  • Samarbeider godt med andre: Du er en lagspiller som bidrar positivt til arbeidsmiljøet.
  • Planlegger og strukturerer: Du har stor arbeidskapasitet, er strukturert og opptatt av å jobbe mot de målene vi har satt oss.
  • Motstandsdyktig: Du er tilpasningsdyktig og trygg i din rolle som veileder. Du takler utfordringer i det daglige arbeidet, og evner å være positiv i krevende situasjoner over tid.
  • Initiativrik: Du identifiserer muligheter for å nå mål, og handler for å forbedre situasjoner uten å vente på spesifikke instruksjoner.
    Vi tilbyr
    • Konkurransedyktig lønn. Se garantilønn her:
      •  https://www.gjesdal.kommune.no/for-ansatte/garantilonn/
    • God pensjonsordning i KLP med lånemuligheter:
      • https://www.klp.no/pensjonsguiden?kommune=Gjesdal+kommune&oftp=1&produkter=1234.#/0 
    • Vi har en personalhytte på Hellvik til utleie for alle ansatte. 
    • Spennende arbeidsoppgaver med mulighet for faglig og personlig utvikling, eksempelvis gjennom videreutdanninger i kollegaveiledning og forvaltningsrett.
    • Trivelig og lærerikt arbeidsmiljø med dyktige kollegaer. 
    • Fleksibel arbeidstid.

    Bedre sammen  - er Gjesdal kommune sin visjon. Med verdiene: 

    • Framtidsretta - Vi ser etter muligheter, og finner bærekraftige løsninger sammen.  
    • Inkluderende - Sammen skaper vi et godt arbeidsmiljø og et trygt samfunn for alle.  
    • Lagspillere - Vi møter andre med respekt, vi samarbeider og gjør hverandre gode.  

    Vi har heltidskultur for å sikre god kvalitet, kontinuitet og kompetanse for alle ansatte og de vi er til for, samt et godt arbeidsmiljø og forutsigbarhet for den enkelte medarbeider. 

    Vi ønsker å være en arbeidsgiver som gjenspeiler mangfoldet i samfunnet. Derfor oppfordrer vi alle kvalifiserte til å søke - uansett alder, kjønn, funksjonsevne, seksuell orientering, religion, etnisitet eller hull i CV-en. 

    Attester og vitnemål
    Vi ber om at du laster opp attester og vitnemål, i PDF-format, sammen med søknaden din. Utenlandske vitnemål må ha norsk godkjenning fra Hk-dir og utenlandske attester oversatt til et skandinavisk språk eller engelsk. Vi gjør oppmerksom på at dokumentasjon på bl.a. verneplikt og omsorg for barn, eldre eller syke også kan gi uttelling på lønnsansiennitet. Ansettelse skjer etter gjeldende regler og tariffavtaler.

    Gjesdal kommune praktiserer prinsippet om meroffentlighet. Offentlig søkerliste vil normalt inneholde navn på samtlige søkere. Det må foreligge tungtveiende grunner for å få innvilget unntak, jamfør Offentleglova §25.

    KontaktinformasjonSynnøve Schei, saksbehandler, NAV arbeidsrettet, +47 41245133

    Om arbeidsgiveren:

    Gjesdal kommune ligger langs E39, omtrent 3 mil sør for Stavanger i Rogaland, og er en mellomstor kommune med i overkant av 12 500 innbyggere. Stor nok til å være spennende, og liten nok til å komme tett på. 

    I Gjesdal finner har vi tettstedene Gilja, Oltedal og Ålgård som alle er omgitt av fantastisk natur og flotte turmuligheter. Gjesdal er godt kjent for sine turistmål som blant annet Månafossen, Gloppedalsura, Kongeparken, Byrkjedalstunet, Norwegian Outlet og Limagarden. 

    Gjesdal er en moderne kommune i en tradisjonell innpakning. Lean-filosofi, kontinuerlig forbedring og lærende organisasjon står sentralt i måten vi jobber på, og vi legger stor vekt på et godt arbeidsmiljø og trivsel for ansatte. Vi jobber aktivt for god folkehelse, et attraktivt lokalsamfunn og tidlig innsats for barn og unge.  

    I Gjesdal kommune får du ikke bare en jobb, men blir en del av et lag med mulighet til å påvirke og utvikle det viktige lokalsamfunnet rundt deg.

title: Fagutviklingssykepleier i nyopprettet sykepleierteam
employer: BÆRUM KOMMUNE HJEMMEBASERTE TJENESTER BEKKESTUA DISTRIKT
description:
Vil du være med å etablere et nytt, overordnet sykepleierteam og forme fremtidens hjemmetjenester i Bærum kommune?

Bærum kommune etablerer et nytt, overordnet sykepleierteam i hjemmebaserte tjenester og søker en engasjert, faglig sterk og utviklingsorientert fagutviklingssykepleier.
Teamet skal bidra med avansert sykepleiefaglig kompetanse og være en viktig ressurs i oppfølgingen av brukere med komplekse og sammensatte behov.

Som fagutviklingssykepleier får du en sentral rolle i å koordinere teamets oppdrag, utvikle arbeidsprosesser og bidra til at teamets kompetanse benyttes der behovene er størst. Som en del av et nyetablert team får du en unik mulighet til å være med på å utvikle og forme teamets rolle og arbeidsmåter.

Du arbeider strukturert, ser sammenhenger på tvers av tjenesten og er opptatt av å finne gode løsninger i en organisasjon i utvikling. I rollen vil du bidra til faglig utvikling, kompetanseheving og samhandling på tvers av tjenestestedene, samtidig som du er en sentral ressurs for ledere og medarbeidere.

Hjemmebaserte tjenester består av fire tjenestesteder: Sandvika, Rykkinn, Østerås og Bekkestua, som til sammen utgjør 10 avdelinger. I tillegg har tjenesten et tjenestested med alle felles ressurser samlet, og teamet ledes av avdelingsleder i Felles ressurser.

Stillingen er en dagstilling. Teamet vil i første omgang være lokalisert på Bekkestua, sentralt med gode kollektivforbindelser og noe mulighet for parkering.
Har du spørsmål eller ønsker en uforpliktende samtale? Ta gjerne kontakt med oss.

Vi ser frem til å motta din søknad!
Tiltredelse etter avtale.

  • Jobber selvstendig og  strukturert, og evner å håndtere mange oppgaver samtidig
  • Har gode samarbeidsevner og bygger relasjoner på tvers av fagområder
  • Kommuniserer tydelig og skaper trygghet rundt deg
  • Er initiativrik, løsningsorientert og fleksibel

Personlig egnethet vil bli tillagt stor vekt.

title: Associate Professor (100 %, three years) in snow science / snow avalanches
employer: UNIVERSITETET I TROMSØ - NORGES ARKTISKE UNIVERSITET UIT CAMPUS TROMSØ
description:
The position

We are seeking a three-year fixed-term Associate Professor with a focus on snow science at the Department of Geosciences at The Faculty of Science and Technology, UiT the Arctic University of Norway. The position is attached to the Solid Earth Science, Mineral Resources and Geohazards scientific group.

Tromsø is a vibrant Arctic city surrounded by dramatic mountains, fjords and accessible wilderness — an exceptional living laboratory for snow and mountain research. The region offers year-round opportunities for fieldwork, easy access to skiing and mountaineering, and outstanding nature experiences (midnight sun in summer, northern lights in winter). We value work-life balance and outdoor culture here, which many researchers find inspiring for both research and personal life.

The workplace is at UiT in Tromsø. You must be able to start in the position in Tromsø within a reasonable time after receiving the offer.


The department

The Department of Geosciences has currently 16 permanent scientific staff positions, 21 post-doctoral fellows and researchers, 24 PhD students and 15 technical/administrative positions. The Department includes three scientific groups: (1) Solid Earth Science, Mineral Resources and Geohazards group, (2) Sedimentary Systems, Paleoclimates and Environments group, and (3) Geophysics, Glaciology and Oceanography group. It also hosts the Centre of Excellence iC3: Centre for ice, Cryosphere, Carbon and Climate . The Department is also a member of iEarth - Centre for Integrated Earth Science Education. We offer courses at all levels from bachelor to PhD studies and hosts approximately 150 students.

Over the last decade, the department has strategically built up expertise and research and education activities in geohazards. Geohazards is now a key focus area for the department, with established networks, ongoing projects and ambitions to further expand capabilities in snow science, avalanches and related processes. Earlier work has focused on rock slopes, slush flows, wet snow avalanches, climate adaptation and hazard/runout modelling. We would like to develop this research direction. The position benefits from active connections to the Department of Physics and Technology, Department of Technology and Safety and the Center for Avalanche Research and Education (CARE), and interdisciplinary research is encouraged to strengthen UiT’s position as a driver of Arctic knowledge, such as incorporating elements of psychology, preparedness and climate research.


The position’s field of research/field of work

The successful candidate is expected to:

  • Conduct high-quality research that strengthens UiT’s snow science portfolio within the snow science and geohazards thematic area. Research may also be interdisciplinary, and a connection with CARE and other UiT institutes is encouraged.
  • Teach undergraduate and advanced graduate courses, as well as participate in teaching of the field courses organized by the scientific group. The successful candidate will be expected to fulfil basic pedagogical competence within two years.
  • Supervise students at all levels, including MSc and PhD students.
  • Build external networks and represent the department at meetings, conferences and community outreach events.
  • Respond to media enquiries within your field.
  • Collaborate with colleagues to secure external funding and contribute to establishing permanent snow science capability at UiT.

It is expected that the participant will participate in disseminating research to a wider public. 


Contact

Further information about the position and UiT is available by contacting

Associate Professor Louise Daines-Vick, phone + 47 90 47 30 83, email: louise.m.vick@uit.no

Professor/Head of Department (interim) Anders Schomacker, phone + 47 95 52 34 64, email: anders.schomacker@uit.no


Qualifications

For this three-year fixed-term position as Associate Professor with a focus on snow science the applicants

  • must have a PhD in geosciences, physics, mathematics or a closely related field and a documented publication record in snow science and/or related geohazards. 
  • must have experience in, and a strong dedication to, field-based research and navigating snowy terrain. A track record or commitment to acquisition of external funding is desired.  The research should complement the existing research strengths within the fields of the Solid Earth Science, Mineral Resources and Geohazards scientific group, which includes the field of geohazards. 
  • must have an ability to communicate effectively in English. 
  • documented pedagogical competence. All applicants for teaching and research positions shall document their pedagogical competence. You must have acquired basic competence for teaching and supervision at higher education level. This includes basic skills in planning, conducting, evaluating and developing teaching and guidance. Those who do not meet the requirements for pedagogical competence upon employment will be required to meet them within two years.
  • Norwegian language skills: The position requires proficiency in a Scandinavian language equivalent to level B2 in the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR). New employees who do not fulfill the language criteria by appointment are required, within three years, to demonstrate sufficient proficiency in Norwegian or another Scandinavian language. Arrangements will be made to facilitate the completion of Norwegian courses.
  • personal suitability: Our working culture is important to us. We will emphasize the applicants motivation for the position and personal suitability. We are looking for candidates who display the following:
    • Collegial team player, ability to cooperate and communicate well with other members of staff and contribute to a good working environment.
    • Strong networking skills, ability to collaborate and conduct scientific leadership
    • Interest in strategy and strategic development of the department.
    • Good communication skills and ability to engage with academic, stakeholder and public audiences.

The applicants should have expertise in one or several aspects of snow avalanches and geohazards. Research approaches may include, for example, remote sensing, numerical and physical modelling, laboratory experiments, and field measurements on snow, slush, debris, or mixed materials. 

At UiT we put emphasis on the quality, relevance and significance of the research work and not on where the work is published, in accordance with the principles of The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment (DORA).


Pedagogical competence

All applicants for teaching and research positions must document their educational competence in their application.

Those who do not meet the requirements for pedagogical competence upon employment will be required to meet them within two years. UiT offers courses in educational competence to employees.

You must have acquired basic competence for teaching and supervision at university and college level.This entails basic skills in planning, implementing, evaluating and developing teaching and supervision. 

See how to document educational competence: About the pedagogical portfolio - Result  (English guide at the bottom of the page)


We offer
  • A stimulating international research environment within the geohazards theme and opportunities for collaboration across UiT.
  • Support for career development, supervision of students and external funding applications
  • Access to university research infrastructure, administrative and technical support, and professional development (mentoring, courses and workshops)
  • You will join a thriving geosciences environment with active projects, a strong student cohort and close interdisciplinary collaboration. You will have access to relevant laboratory and field equipment, opportunities to participate in and lead field campaigns, and support for outreach and stakeholder engagement
  • Allocated funds to support your research, travel and equipment needs
  • Good welfare arrangements for employees
  • Good arrangements for pension, insurance and loans in the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund
  • Access to the department cabin Heiahytta for a reasonable rental fee
  • If you have to relocate to Tromsø then the Faculty of Science and Technology may reimburse your moving costs. Further details regarding this matter will be made available if you receive an offer from us.

 

Norwegian health policy aims to ensure that everyone, irrespective of their personal finances and where they live, has access to good health and care services of equal standard. As an employee you will become member of the National Insurance Scheme which also include health care services.


Work- and salary conditions 

The successful candidate must be willing to get involved in the ongoing development of their department and the university as a whole.

The allocation of working hours is flexible and allocated on a case-by-case basis. In general, Associate Professors will spend an equal amount of time on teaching and research and development work after time spent on other duties has been deducted. As a norm, the time resources spent on administrative duties constitutes 5 % for academic staff. 

The remuneration for Associate Professor is in accordance with the State salary scale code 1011, with a gross annual salary ranging from NOK 700000,-  to 900000,- in a 100 % position. In special cases, a higher salary may be considered. 

As a state employee, you have one of the best pension schemes available. For more information see: spk.no.


Application

The application must include: 

  • Cover letter including a short description of interests and reasons for applying for the position  
  • CV containing a complete overview of education, experience and professional work 
  • Diplomas, diploma supplements and transcripts (all degrees, in original language and translated) 
  • Letter(s) of recommendation if applicable
  • Two references with contact details 
  • Documented pedagogical competence. Brief description of teaching philosophy/documentation of educational competence in the form of a pedagogical map or course certificate of completed university pedagogical basic competence such as UNIPED 100 at UiT or equivalent from other universities 
  • A list of your academic production 
  • Description of your academic production, stating which works you consider most important 
  • Academic works, up to ten. The doctoral thesis is regarded as one work. 
  • Documentation of English proficiency.  

Proficiency in the English language can be documented in the following ways: 

  • Diploma from a Norwegian upper secondary school with both spoken and written English (140 hours) 
  • TOEFL (Test of English as a Foreign Language) 
  • IELTS (International English Testing Service) 
  • Completed university degree in the field of English language or literature 
  • One year of completed university studies in Australia, Canada, Ireland, New Zealand, the UK or USA, for which English was the language of instructions. 

Documentation has to be in English or a Scandinavian language. The application and submitted documents must be sent electronically via www.jobbnorge.no 


Assessment

The applicants will be assessed by an expert committee. The committee's mandate is to undertake an assessment of the applicants' qualifications on the basis of the written material presented by the applicants, and the detailed description drawn up for the position.

The applicants who are assessed as best qualified will be called to an interview. The interview shall among other things, aim to clarify the applicants personal suitability for the position and motivations. A trial lecture may also be held.


General information

The appointment is made in accordance with State regulations and guidelines at UiT. At our website, you will find more information for applicants.

The engagement is to be made in accordance with the acts relating to Control of the Export of Strategic Goods, Services and Technology. Candidates who by assessment of the application and attachment are seen to conflict with the criteria in the latter law will be prohibited from recruitment.

After the appointment you must assume that there may be changes in the area of work.

More information about moving to Norway and working at UiT: http://uit.no/mobility

​According to the Norwegian Freedom and Information Act (Offentleglova) information about the applicant may be included in the public applicant list, also in cases where the applicant has requested non-disclosure.

In case of discrepancies between the Norwegian and the English version of this description, the Norwegian version takes precedence. 


Om arbeidsgiveren:

UiT The Arctic University of Norway is an internationally leading broad-based university. Our vision is to be a driving force in the North. The Northern Sami term eallju, which means diligence, sets the tone for UiT's drive. Together with students, staff, and society at large, we will utilizeour location in Northern Norway and Sápmi, our academic breadth, and interdisciplinary advantages to shape the future.
 

UiT has approximately18,000 students, more than 4,000 employees, and is established across four main campuses and seven additional study locations in Northern Norway and on Svalbard. Our largest campuses are Tromsø, Alta ,Narvik, and Harstad. UiT has seven faculties, 40 departments and centers, and leading research environments in various fields. The university offers 269 study programs and focuses on educational quality.

Academic freedom, scientific principles, and research ethics form the foundation of all UiT'sactivities. Participation, co-determination,
transparency, and sound processes will provide the basis for making wise and forward-looking decisions. Our students and staff will have the opportunity to develop their abilities and potential. Rooted in scientific integrity, we aim to be bold, engaged, and generous -closely connected to academia, people, and contemporary developments

title: Founding Growth Marketer
description:
Who we are looking for

We're looking for a Founding Growth Marketer to build Birdsview's growth engine from the ground up, the person who turns "we have a great product" into a steady flow of qualified pipeline. AI first person.

Birdsview - Prolonging the lifetime of the built world

Birdsview is a Norwegian technology company on a mission to change the way we preserve critical infrastructure to ensure a more sustainable and secure future.

Infrastructure is one of society’s most important assets. It includes the buildings we live in, the bridges we cross and the power grid that provides us with electricity. These structures are aging rapidly, and solutions that help preserve and secure critical infrastructure are now needed more than ever.

Birdsview's state-of-the-art technology combines radar (GPR), lidar, and AI to visualize what’s inside structures without destructive interventions. This allows for efficient and cost-effective inspection and monitoring of our most precious infrastructures - and enables clear, user-friendly visualizations that enhance understanding, extend asset lifespan, and promote material reuse - ultimately reducing costs and CO₂ emissions.

We are 17 people, we have customers in 9 countries, and we raised NOK 40.5 million from leading Nordic VC's to scale internationally.

About the job and why it matters

Much of concrete inspection today still relies on manual methods and fragmented, ageing non-destructive testing (NDT) equipment. You will help structural engineers, contractors, surveying specialists, and asset owners see clearly what is hidden inside the concrete. New critical data, faster inspections, and real cost savings are why they want our technology in their daily projects.

As a Founding Growth Marketer, you will be the engine of our international growth. The role is hands-on: you'll use AI tools to build and test campaigns across channels, turn technical value into content that resonates with engineers and asset owners, run experiments to find what actually converts, and hand qualified leads to our sales team. This is a foundational role in a newly formed marketing function, where you will have a direct impact on our strategy, processes, and success.

  • Build the engine
    You'll design and implement our full growth marketing engine, taking a foundational role in shaping our strategy.

  • Own demand generation
    Own demand generation across content, paid, and organic channels, directly impacting qualified lead flow to sales. You're measured on qualified leads reaching sales.

  • Find the message that lands
    Test positioning against our different customer segments; engineers, contractors, asset owners and find the one we can scale. Nobody has the answer yet.

  • Work the funnel with sales
    Hand qualified leads to our sales team, and use what they hear back to sharpen the next campaign.

  • Build the measurement
    Set up tracking, reporting, and analytics to measure performance, identify effective strategies, and drive continuous improvement.

  • Make the technical obvious
    Leverage AI tools to create and test innovative campaigns that translate complex technical value into resonant messages for our target audience.

What we're looking for

  • AI-first, systematic and test-driven. You run experiments, read the data, and a campaign that flops doesn't slow you down.

  • Proven ability to build and run a complete growth engine: lead generation, content, paid campaigns, organic channels.

  • Skills in setting up tracking, reporting and analytics, so performance is measured rather than asserted.

  • Experience developing, testing and refining positioning and messaging, in collaboration with sales and leadership.

  • 1–3 years of experience in B2B growth or marketing, ideally in a startup or scale-up. Hands-on and results-oriented, this is a building role.

  • Fluent English; Norwegian is an advantage.

  • Based in Bergen or Oslo, or willing to relocate.

Why this is interesting

  • Top-tier colleagues
    Work alongside leading people in a supportive and ambitious team culture, with regular social events and company trips.

  • Build it yourself
    Be a foundational member, directly shaping our international sales strategy and playbook.

  • Room to grow
    We're building the commercial team right now. What you own in a year depends on what you build in the first six months.

  • Compensation
    Competitive salary and equity - become an owner.

  • Impact
    Make a tangible impact on preserving critical infrastructure and fostering a circular economy.

  • Location
    Work in Bergen or Oslo with a fast-moving, hands-on team. Excellent working facilities at StartupLab centrally located in both cities.

View the full details for the job here.

description:
Vi trenger et nytt medlem på vårt lag, og ser etter en engasjert og trygg personlig assistent til en blid, sosial ungdom på 18 år. Truls bor sammen med mor, stefar og en hund på Huseby.

Jobben består i å støtte Truls i hans hverdagsliv og fritid, både alene og sammen med familien. Det betyr alt fra å være tilgjengelig i bakgrunnen for å støtte med praktiske ting når det trengs, til å støtte han på utflukter med buss og bil for å for eksempel gå på biblioteket, kjøpesenter eller McDonalds og bowling. Han er også veldig glad i å være ute på turer med elektrisk rullestol eller el-tandemsykkelen sin. Inne er det mye musikk, Mario kart på nintento switch, tegning og Youtube, tøys og tull.

Du må ha førerkort og erfaring med bilkjøring slik at du kan kjøre familiens bil, som er en stasjonsvogn med automatgir. Gutten bruker en lett elektrisk rullestol når han skal gå lenger enn korte avstander. Han har også en utviklingshemming, men har et godt språk. Disse to tingene innebærer at jobben også består av støtte til personlig hygiene, og noe støtte til forflytting. Det er derfor en forutsetning at du har god helse, for å være trygg med støtte i trapper og inn og ut av bil og løfte rullestol inn og ut av bil.

Hos oss er det masse latter, tøys og liv. Dette er en jobb der mer enn halve jobben er å være godt selskap for Truls. Men det er viktig at du er punktlig og pliktoppfyllende, har gode norskferdigheter og er god på å kommunisere. Du vil få all nødvendig opplæring av mor og stefar, men også av andre assistenter i ordningen. Ta gjerne kontakt om du er usikker på hva jobben går ut på, om å være assistent kan være noe for deg, eller hvordan det er å jobbe hjemme hos noen, så tar vi en prat.

Hvordan er vaktene:

Siden Truls går på skole, er det ettermiddag, helger og i ferier vaktene ligger. 2-3 helgevakter i måneden med 6-8 timers vakter, enten dag/ettermiddag eller kveld. Det er en fast ettermiddagsvakt hver uke fra kl.16-22, og noen uker to vakter. I tillegg dukker det alltid opp ekstravakter.

Vi ser etter deg som er:

  • Glad i spill, musikk, bilkjøring og vitser
  • Selvgående, ser ting som må gjøres og ikke redd for å ta i et tak.
  • Løsningsorientert
  • Ansvarsfull og selvstendig
  • Tålmodig og trygg på deg selv
  • Erfaring med barn eller ung ungdom er ønskelig, men formell kompetanse er ikke nødvendig

Om arbeidsgiveren:

BPA er en forkortelse for brukerstyrt personlig assistanse. Det er i hovedsak en alternativ måte å organisere praktisk bistand på for funksjonshemmede. BPA skiller seg fra mer tradisjonelle tjenester ved at det er personen med assistansebehov som selv bestemmer hvordan assistansen skal være. BPA er et frigjørings- og likestillingsverktøy som bidrar til at den med assistansebehov får frihet til å leve et selvstendig og aktivt liv - på lik linje med andre i samfunnet. Prima Assistanse har spesialisert seg på BPA, og er i dag en betydelig leverandør i hele Norge. Vi jobber hver dag for å bidra til at funksjonshemmede får den friheten og assistansen som er nødvendig for å kunne leve et selvstendig liv. Vi er opptatt av å levere et godt konsept, kvalitet i alle ledd, å ha profesjonelle medarbeidere og gode rutiner, slik at vi sammen bidrar til en suksessfull hverdag. Nysgjerring på hvordan det er å jobbe hos oss? Les mer på vår karriereside: https://prima-assistanse.no/karriere/jobbe-som-bpa-assistent/

title: PhD Research Fellow in Multi-Level Resistive Memory Cells for Ternary Computing
description:
Welcome to USN

The University of Southeastern Norway (USN) ranks as the country's fourth largest higher education institution. We are a vibrant community of approximately 18,000 students and 1,900 employees.

Video: https://vimeo.com/898549899/60305e2540About the position

The Faculty of Technology, Natural Sciences and Maritime Sciences invites applications for a 100% PhD Research Fellow position in fabrication and characterization of multi-level resistive memory technology. The position is a three-year, full-time research appointment with no teaching obligations.

The doctoral programme in Technology comprises approximately six months (30 ECTS) of coursework, an article-based thesis demonstrating independent research, active participation in national and international research environments, research dissemination, a trial lecture, and public defence. Read more in our PhD handbook. Admission to the Faculty's doctoral programme in Technology must be applied for and granted within three months of starting the position.

The place of work is at Campus Vestfold (Raveien 215, Borre, Norway. Located on campus is the MST-lab, part of the national NorFab infrastructure for fabrication and characterization. Your personnel manager will be Marius Tannum (Head of department, Microsystems, Campus Vestfold).


About the doctoral project

Resistive memory (ReRAM, also known as memristors) has matured rapidly. It offers fast writes at lower power, has high endurance and non-volatile retention. Recently Nordic Semiconductor released the nRF54L microcontroller series which feature binary ReRAM to replace flash memory at scale. Multi-level operation, however, remains challenging with device-to-device and cycle-to-cycle variation, state drift, read disturbs and non-linear multi-state programming. This PhD project aims to address these issues by fabricating and characterizing ReRAM cells optimized for balanced ternary (symbols -1, 0 and 1), storing ~58% more information per cell than binary. This enables exciting applications like ternary neural networks, ultra-efficient event-based cameras, high-density storage and mixed-radix 3D SoCs.

Building on our preliminary work with 3-level ReRAM devices you will mainly work on task 1, with a possibility to work on task 2 in parallel.

Task 1: Fabrication of ternary ReRAM cells. ReRAM cells are metal-insulator-metal (MIM) stacks that can be deposited by sputtering or atomic layer deposition. Making a functional multi-level device that is reliable with three (or powers of three) well separated resistance levels and is reproducible at wafer scale is the main challenge.  You will fabricate and characterize the devices in USN’s MST fab in Vestfold and can use other Norfab cleanroom infrastructure if necessary. Extensive characterization activities (pulsed and DC I-V, retention, endurance, device-to-device variability, etc.) are expected using automated measurements setups and with carefully designed experiments to turn the raw data into publishable insights. 

Task 2: Design of an on/off-chip ternary ReRAM controller. You will design mixed-signal, mixed-radix circuitry for writing and reading radix-3 states on commercially available ReRAM devices with the devices from task 1 as the long-term target. The digital control logic for radix-3 states can be written in ternary HDL using our group’s EDA tools (MRCS Studio) and ternary RTL-to-GDS synthesis flows. For this task you will use commercial foundries to tape-out and validate correct operation for a selection of suitable ReRAM devices. 

You will join USN’s Ternary Research Group, founded in 2019 by Assoc. Prof. Steven Bos and Assoc. Prof. Henning Gundersen. The research group provides an active research environment which includes MSc students and PhD research fellows working on carbon nanotube-based (CNTFET) switching devices and sensors compatible with ternary logic. 


Qualifications

Eligibility Requirements:

  • A Master’s degree (120 ECTS) or equivalent higher education qualifications in Micro/Nanoelectronics, Electronic/Electrical Engineering, Nanotechnology, Materials Science and Engineering, Physics or related fields.
  • The master’s degree must have been obtained by the application deadline for the position. 
  • Strong background in electronics, chip design, microfabrication and / or material science. 
  • Weighted average grade of B or higher on the master’s degree and thesis. 
  • Excellent written and spoken English with documented proficiency.

Ideal applicants have:

  • Hands-on experience in cleanroom environment for microfabrication or comprehensive knowledge of microfabrication fundamentals. 
  • Good understanding of CMOS chip design flows, or proficiency in relevant EDA tools such as Cadence Virtuoso, (H)SPICE simulation  
  • Experience in electrical characterization (probe station, DC and pulsed I-V, retention and endurance testing, instrument automation)
  • Experience writing Verilog-A and/or RTL in (System)Verilog or VHDL
  • Relevant master’s thesis or major projects aligned with the PhD project, for example in memristive devices, emerging non-volatile memory, mixed-signal design or microfabrication

Applicants should document which of these qualifications they possess. Any experience with multiple valued logic and/or AI tools for chip design and verification is counted as positive. 

It is a requirement that the successful applicant is granted admission to the university’s doctoral programme in technology within three months of accession in the position. For admission to the Programme the weighted average grade is B or higher is usually required. 

The applicant must have the ability to work independently and at the same time have the motivation to share knowledge and take part in teamwork. Personal suitability for the post will be emphasized.

Co-operation between staff members is an integrated part of the working atmosphere at the University of South-Eastern Norway. The applicant must be motivated and demonstrate a proven ability to work effectively within a team and in a collegiate manner to formulate and realize common objectives. 


Personal qualities
  • Strongly motivated and ambitious. 
  • Be structured, targeted and solution oriented. 
  • The successful applicant should be creative and actively contribute to the team he/she will be part of.  
  • Have good dissemination skills. 
  • Personal skills like a positive and friendly attitude and contributing to a sustainable social environment will also be valued.

When assessing applications, particular importance will be attached to
  • Formal qualifications
  • The scientific quality, research relevance and degree of innovation of the project
  • The relevance of the project to the profile of the doctoral programme
  • The personal qualities mentioned above

Requirements for proficiency in English 

This position requires good English language skills. International applicants must document this with a valid certificate from one of the following tests. Specific requirements regarding grades can be found on our webpage English requirement for programmes and subjects taught in English at USN.

  • TOEFL – Test of English as a Foreign Language, Internet-Based Test (IBT)
  • IELTS – International English Language Testing Service 
  • Certificate in Advanced English (CAE) or Certificate of Proficiency in English (CPE) from the University of Cambridge
  • PTE Academic – Pearson Test of English Academic

The following applicants are exempt from the requirements listed above:

  • Applicants with one year of completed university studies in Australia, Canada, Ireland, New Zealand, UK or USA
  • Applicants who have completed a master’s degree with English as the language of instruction in an EU or EEA country
  • Applicants who are exempt based on the Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir)’s GSU list (Higher Education Entrance Qualification for foreign applicants)

Applicants from Norway can confirm their English language skills by submitting their upper secondary school diploma.


What we offer
  • A stimulating and growing research environment
  • Careers advice and guidance throughout the entire doctoral programme. Together we will draw up a career plan that includes the skills and knowledge you will acquire
  • An inclusive working environment with ambitious colleagues
  • The opportunity to take Norwegian language courses
  • Salary in accordance with the Norwegian State salary scale for PhD research fellows (position code 1017) NOK 550,800. Any further increases in pay grade will be based on length of service in the position

Diversity

We believe diversity is a strength in our work and learning environment. Different experiences and backgrounds contribute to better solutions for the challenges we aim to solve. 

We are committed to respecting individual differences and accommodating employees with disabilities. We consider your needs and situation during different stages of life. 

If this position interests you, we encourage you to apply regardless of gender, disability, cultural background, or whether you have had a career break. 

Qualified candidates with disabilities, employment gaps, or immigrant backgrounds will be invited to an interview. If you identify with one of these groups, you may indicate this in our job portal.


General information

The Appointment Committee for Fellowship Positions (TUS) is the appointing authority for this position. Your competence for the position will be assessed by an expert committee. The expert committee will assess your competence for the position based on the documentation you have registered in Jobbnorge. 

Based on the expert committee’s assessment, relevant applicants will be invited to an interview and to hold a trial lecture. References will also be obtained for relevant applicants. 

Employment at USN is carried out in accordance with the principles set out in the Norwegian Civil Service Act, and the legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services. If your application is considered to be in conflict with the criteria in the latter legislation, it will be rejected without further consideration.

The University’s Guidelines for recruitment positions at the University of South-Eastern Norway (Guidelines for recruitment positions) provide a more detailed description of the criteria for appointment as a PhD research fellow. 

As an employee of USN, you must at all times adapt to changes in the field and all organisational changes that are adopted.


Requirements regarding export licence

For the position, an export license is required, and the applicant must meet the requirements for this. You can read more about export licenses on DEKSA's website.


How to apply

If you think this position looks interesting and matches your qualifications, you can submit an application electronically by clicking on “Apply for the position” on this page. Here you will need to enter a short application text and information about your relevant education and work experience. In the application text, you must clearly describe your skills and motivation for the position. 

The application must include:

  • Cover letter outlining the motivation (1 page) and a detailed Curriculum Vitae (CV)
  • Applicants must submit a preliminary research proposal with the application. The project description for the research project should be short and concise, maximum 2–3 pages (600-900 words). [See further descriptions in the “Template for project descriptions for doctoral and postdoctoral fellowships at USN”  (Project description):
    • 1.      Introduction (the title, main problem and research questions and the background to the project)
    • 2.      State of the art (the project’s research field)
    • 3.      Theory
    • 4.      Methodology
    • 5.      Work plan
    • 6.      Results and hypotheses
    • 7.      Bibliography
    • Applications with a project description exceeding 900 words will not be processed.
    • The project proposal will be included in the assessment of the applicant’s competence.
  • Certified diplomas for your bachelor’s and master’s degrees (120 ECTS). The diplomas must be in a Scandinavian language or English
    • Applicants with higher education completed outside Norway must provide documentation that the education has been recognised and approved by the Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir) You must submit your application for approval before the position’s application deadline. Attach a receipt or decision when applying. The approval must be forwarded once available and is a requirement for employment.
  • An explanation of the grading system for foreign education (diploma supplement if available)
  • Your master’s thesis. If your master’s thesis was a collaborative project, you must submit a short statement detailing your involvement
  • Other relevant certificates and diplomas
  • Documentation of your English language skills
    • Language proficiency in English can be documented in the following ways (see above: Requirements for proficiency in English)
  • List of any scholarly publications
  • Contact information for up to three references

The application will be assessed based on the information available in Jobbnorge at the expiry of the application deadline. Make sure your application shows clearly how your skills and experience meet the competence requirements described in the job advertisement. 

When assessing who is best qualified for the position, we attach weight to education, experience and personal qualities. 

All documentation must be provided in a Scandinavian language or English. If the attachments exceed 30 MB in total, they must be compressed before uploading.

Please note that information about you as an applicant may be disclosed publicly even if you have requested not to be included on the public list of applicants (cf. Section 25 of the Norwegian Freedom of Information Act).  You will be notified if your request for exemption from public disclosure is denied.

We only consider applications and attachments registered in Jobbnorge. On request, you must be able to provide certified copies of your documentation.


Contact information

Head of Department Marius Stian Tannum + 31 00 90 19 / marius.tannum@usn.no  

or Ass.Professor/Main Supervisor Steven Bos  + 47 35 02 65 02/ steven.bos@usn.no

About the Faculty and Department

The Faculty of Technology, Natural Sciences and Maritime Sciences (TNM) offers education and research across technology, engineering, natural sciences, and maritime disciplines. 

The Department of Microsystems is located on the Vestfold campus.
